tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sman gyi bstan bcos sman ming rgya mtsho bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ar+ya pra na pra bha su dam su tra ma ghu at+mi ta aṇa hri dha ya na ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde las byung ba'i/ bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa sman pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ zla gsum dbyar te zla gsum ston du shes// gsum ni dgun te gsum ni dpyid yin no// de ltar zla ba'i go rim dus ni drug /lo gcig la ni zla ba bcu gnyis 'dod// gsum gsum du ni tshig rnams dus ston shes// zla ba gnyis gnyis shing gi dus su bstan// zas dang skom ni de ltar 'ju bar 'gyur// sman pa dag ni khams dang dus kyang bstan// dbang po dang ni khams rnams de dag kyang*// lo gcig gcig nang tshigs tshigs yongs su gyur// dbang po dag ni yongs su 'gyur bas na// lus can rnams la sna tshogs nad kyang 'byung*// de nyid la ni sman pas zla gsum bzhi// tshigs kyi bar du dus drug rnams dang ni// khams drug mkhas pa rnam par shes par bya// zas skom sman dang go rim ji bzhin pa// rlung ni shas che'i nad ni dbyar na ldang*// ston du gyur pa la ni mkhris pa g.yo// dgun gyi dus su de bzhin 'dus pa ste// bad kan shas che'i nad ni dpyid ldang ngo*// dbyar ni snum dro lan tsha skyur ba'i ro// ston ni mngar dang lan tsha bsil ba'o// dgun ni mngar dang skyur dang snum pas te// dpyid kyi dus su rtsub dro tsha ba'o// bad kan che ba zos ma thog tu ldang*// mkhris pa che ba 'ju ba'i dus su ldang*// rlung shas che ba zhu ma thog tu ldang*// khams gsum g.yo ba de ni de ltar ro// rlung gi bdag nyid la ni bcud kyis gso// bkru sman gyis ni mkhris pa gso bar bya// 'dus pa la ni gsum dang mthun ldan pa// bad kan tshigs su babs na skyugs sman btang*// rlung shas che dang mkhris pa 'dus pa dang*// bad kan shas che'i tshigs rnams shes par bya// dus gang khams gang lus ni gang yin pa// de yi sman dang zas skom bsten par bya// zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs te/

sman gyi rgyal pos rtsa don thams cad mkhyen// ma rig chags sdang zhe sdang nad sel ba'i// gnas skabs mthar thug gso ba'i thabs la mkhas// rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen la phyag 'tshal lo// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'gro la rab brtse zhing*// nyes gsum nad kyis sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad// tshe ring longs spyod bde ba'i 'bras bu rtsol// drang srong bla ma brgyud par bcas la 'dud// tshe yi rig byed gso ba'i gzhung rnams las// rgya cher bshad cing rnam grangs dpag med kyang*// tshe thung bsod nams dman pas rtogs dka'i phyir// tshigs nyung don gsal bstan bcos bshad par bya// tshe'i rig byed ma lus mdor bsdus na// gnas skabs su mi na bar gnas shing*/ na ba gso bar bya ba/ de yi 'bras bu tshe ring nad med pa dang*/ gnas skabs kyi bde ba dang*/ mthar thug gi bde ba sgrub pa dang*/ gzhan gyi don la brtson pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis kyang 'jug par bya'o// de bas na tshe'i rig byed thams cad kyang bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su gnas te/ sman pa'i rgyal po dpal ldan pha gol gyi slob mar khas blangs pa'i zla dga' la sogs rnams kyang 'di ltar bzhed de/ sman gyi lung dang gser 'od dam pa dang*// gso dpyad 'bum pa la sogs bka' yin te// rtsa ra ka dang mdo lnga la sogs pa// phyi nang drang srong gis mdzad bstan bcos yin// zhes tshangs pa dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ khyab 'jug gis bshad pa rnams kyang phyi rol pa rnams bkar 'chad mod kyis/ de dag kyang sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs te dran bshad na bka' yin par 'gyur la/ dus gsum dran du dran na ni bstan bcos su 'gyur la/ 'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis gsungs ba'i bka' nyid bshad par bya'o// lugs sde chen po bzhi la/ drang srong gi lugs ni/ rgyun shes kyi bu nabs so skyes dang*/ thang la 'bar dang*/ dka' gnyis spyod dang*/

mu khyud 'gro skyong gi bu dang*/ me bzhin 'jug dang*/ lug nag dang*/ rgya skyegs sna dang*/ mda'i mchog lan tsha'i lag zhes bya ba'i drang srong rnams kyi rtsa ra ka la sogs pa rnams so sor bya'o// tshangs pas gso dpyad 'bum dang*/ skye rgu'i bdag po myur ba dang*/ lha'i sman pa tha skar dkar/ brgya byin gyis mdzad pa rnams te/ drang srong rnams kyang 'di dag gi rjes su 'jug pa nyid do// lha dbang phyug gi rgyud la bshad pa nag gi mu stegs pa'i lugs zhes 'chad mod kyis/ de yang lha dang drang srong nyid do// nang pa'i lugs ni/ sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed/ mdo lnga la sogs pa'i bstan bcos 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rnams dang*/ thams cad snying po bsdus pa slob dpon pha gol gyi 'bum bsdus dang*/ yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po/ de'i 'grel pa zla ba la mngon par dga' bas mdzad pa'i tshig gi zla zer dang*/ snying po bsdus pa la sogs pa rnams dang*/ gzhan paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas grub rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos dpag tu med pa thams cad ni/ rgya gar nas byung ba'o// de tsam du bsdu ba yang min te/ rgya nag dang*/ khrom dang*/ ge sar dang*/ stag gzig la sogs yul nas byung ba'i gso ba'i bstan bcos dpag tu med pa yod do// de dag thams cad tshe'i rig byed yan lag brgyad dang 'dus te/ shin tu mthor ba de rnams las// rab gces phal cher bsdus pa ni// shin tu bsdus min rgyas min par// yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po byas// zhes so// de las spyir tshe'i rig byed zhes bya ba'i tshe ni 'tsho ba ste/ lus dang dbang po sems can dag /'dus pa bzhi ni 'tsho ba ste// rtag par 'gro zhing rjes 'grengs pa// tshe yi rnam grangs yin par bshad// ces bya ba yin la/ tshe de ring bar byed pas na tshe'i rig byed de/ ji ltar zhe na/ phan pa dang phan pa ma yin pa dang*/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba dang*/ tshad ma dang tshad ma min pa las shes par bya'o// de yang lung las/

lus la phan dang mi phan bde// sdug bsngal de'i tshe phan mi phan// gang gi tshad du bshad pa ni// tshe yi rig byed yin par bshad// ces so// mdor bsdus na ming bzhi dang gzugs kyi phung po rigs mthun pa'i sems can gyi khams bzung nas mthar ma 'gags kyi bar la/ tshe'i tha snyad du mdzad la/ de brtan par byed pa'i ltos rnams la rig byed ces bya'o// de nyid la yan lag brgyad yod de/ de yang slob dpon pha gol gyis/ lus dang byis pa gdon lus stod// mtshon dang mche ba rgas ro btsa'o// gso dpyad gang la mi gnas pa'i// yan lag brgyad par de bshad de// zhes gsungs te/ de la lus kyi gso ba ni/ yan lag thams cad brten pa'i nad rigs dang*/ 'khru ba dang*/ skrangs pa dang*/ khrag dang*/ mkhris pa la sogs pa nye bar zhi bar byed pa'i don no// byis pa gso ba ni/ gzhon nu gso ba ni/ ma'i nu zhos nyes pa sbyangs ba'i phyir te/ gnod par byed pa'i nu zho las byung ba'i nad gzhi zhi bar byed pa'i don no// gdon gso ba ni/ lha dang lha ma yin dang dri za dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ klu la sogs pa'i gdon zin pa'i nad la/ zhi ba'i las dang gtor ma la sogs pa gdon nye bar zhi ba'i don du bya'o// lus kyi stod yan lag gso ba ni/ nam tshong yan chad du stong pa'i nad kyi gnas 'gyur ba de/ mig dang*/ rna ba dang*/ sna dang*/ kha la sogs par nad nye bar zhi ba'i don du bya'o// mtshon gyi rma gso ba ni/ rtsa dang shing rtsa rdo dang sa rdul dang*/ lcags dang bong ba dang*/ rus pa dang*/ skra sen mo dang sna tshogs kyi rnag 'dzag pa dang*/ nang du nub pa'i zug rngu dbyung ba'i don du bya'o// mche ba gso ba ni/ sbrul dang chu srin la sogs pa gso ba dang*/ dug sna tshogs kyis bcom pa nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir don du bya'o// rgas pa gso ba ni/ lang tsho la gnas par bya ba dang*/ tshe dang blo gros 'phel bar bya ba dang*/

nad nye bar zhi ba'i don du bya'o// ro btsa' gso bar bya ba ni/ ro btsa' bar bya ba'i phyir gdug pa dang*/ zad pa dang*/ skam pa rnams sa bon 'phel zhing rab tu dwangs pa dang*/ dga' ba bskyed pa'i phyir bya'o// de ltar na yan lag rnam pa brgyad bshad pa yin no// bka' brgyad pa las ni/ lus dang byis pa mo nad gdon// mtshon dug rgas dang btsa' ba dang*// yan lag brgyad du bshad par bya// zhes 'byung zhing 'dir lus kyi nang du stod smad rnams sde tshan byis pa dang mo nad gnyis tha dad du snang*/ slob dpon gyis ni nad kyi spyi'i lus dang*/ bye brag dbang po gnyis su phye nas mo nad byis pa gcig tu mdzad do// drang srong gi gzhung lugs tha dad pa yin/ gcig la gcig 'gal bar mi bsam mo// gso dpyad thams cad yan lag brgyad du 'dus pas bka' brgyad pa'i rgyud bzhi po thams cad bsdu na/ de ltar rtsa ba'i rgyud la le'u drug /bshad pa'i rgyud la le'u sum cu gcig /man ngag rgyud la le'u dgu bcu gnyis// phyi ma'i rgyud la le'u nyi shu lnga// rgyud bzhi bsdoms pas brgya dang lnga bcu bzhi// mjug don yongs su gtad dang lnga bcu drug /de dag yan lag brgyad du 'dus pa ste// lus la bdun cu byis pa mo nad dang*// dug gsum 'don lnga mam lnga bcud len gcig /ro btsa' la gnyis rgyud gsum spyir khyab yin// zhes rtsa rgyud las 'byung ngo*// ltos la ni mdor bstan le'u sum cu so gcig dang*/ lus kyi gnas le'u drug /nad gzhi'i gnas le'u bcu drug dang*/ gso ba'i gnas le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang*/ cho ga grub pa'i gnas le'u drug dang*/ rgyud phyi ma'i le'u bzhi bcu ste/ de ltar le'u brgya dang nyi shu/ gnas ni drug tu bshad pa yin/ zhes gsungs te/ bka' dang bstan bcos kyi gzhung 'di yi tshul gyis bstan bcos ji snyed pa thams cad bsdus so// 'di rnams la gso dpyad zhes bya ba'i don ni/

nad gsal zhing zhi bar byed nas khams mnyam par bya ba'i don gyi bya'o// de yang lung las/ sman la sogs pa rnam pa bzhi// mngar bas khams ni 'gyur ba la// khams snyoms phyir ni rab 'jug pa// gso dpyad ces ni bya bar bshad// zhes 'byung ba yin no// bcom ldan 'das 'dir gser 'od dam pa'i mdo las/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' chu 'bebs su gyur pa na/ sman pa chen po ras pa 'dzin las/ tshigs su bcad pa dgu po 'di gsan te/ tshe'i rig byed ma lus pa mkhyen par gyur pas/ 'di la don rnam pa gnyis te/ gso bar bya ba'i phyir gzhi shes par bya ba tshigs su bcad pa bzhis bstan te/ nyes pa 'byung ba gso ba dang bcas pa ni tshigs bcad lngas bstan to// dang po la tshigs su bcad pa phyed gnyis kyi dus dang tshigs bcad gcig gis dus 'dir gso ba'i lus dang*/ phyed kyis nad ji ltar 'byung ba dang*/ gcig gis mi na bar gnas par bya ba'i tshul gsungs so// dang po ni/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la de'i skad cig zhes bya/ de'i skad cig ma gsum ni dbugs dbyung rngub gcig zhes bya/ dbugs drug la chu srang*/ dbugs sum brgya drug bcu ni chu tshod/ de drug cu ni zhag gcig ste/ dbugs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya bcu'o// zhag sum cu ni zla ba/ zla ba bcu gnyis ni lo ste/ de brgya la ni skyes bu'i tshe mthar phyin pa zhes bya'o// 'di yi dbyar zla gsum ni/ gang du zla ba'i mar ngo la nyi ma zlog pa ni dbyar zla ra ba yar ngo la zlog pa ni 'bring po shes par bya ste/ kar ka ḍa dang*/ 'khrig pa dang*/ seng ge'i khyim ni dbyar gsum mo// ston zla gsum ni/ bu mo dang*/ srang dang*/ sdig pa'i khyim gsum mo// dgun zla gsum ni/ gzhu dang*/ chu srin dang*/ bum pa'i khyim gsum ste/ nyi ma zlog pa yang gong dang tshul mtshungs te/ dpyid zla gsum ni/ nya dang*/ lug dang*/ glang gi khyim gsum ste/

dus chen bzhi po 'di ni zla ba gnyis gnyis kyis dus ni drug go /lo gcig la zla ba bcu gnyis su 'dod la/ mi rnams kyi skye ba dang gnas pa dang*/ 'chi ba na dus de dag tu 'byung bas/ thog ma nyid du dus shes par bya ba yin/ 'di dag gi khams kyang*/ dbyar zla ba gnyis pa dang zhag bcu gnyis ni/ me'i khams stobs su gyur pas khongs na gnas shing rlung phyir skyed par byed do// de bzhin du ston gyi zhag bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni phyir mkhris pa'i me g.yo zhing nang du babs pa dang me'i stobs su gyur pa'i nus pa sogs pa'i lcags kyi khams zhes bya'o// rgyu mtshan des dgun gyis zhag bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni/ sa dang*/ me dang*/ rlung gi khams 'dus pa'i phyir 'phel te nang du chu'i khams stobs su 'gyur ro// chu dang sa'i rang bzhin las dpyid kyi zhag bdun cu don gnyis ni bad kan chu'i khams phyir mdangs shing*/ sa chu gnyis kyi nus pa mnyam par 'phel bas/ shing gi khams nang du stobs su 'gyur ro// shing las me'i khams byung bas s+ya ma lta me nang du dbyar 'phel bar 'gyur ro// zla ba tha chung bzhi yi zhag po bco brgyad kyi nus pa ni sa'i khams nyid stobs dang ldan pas/ 'di dag gi dus so sor mthun pa'i zas skom gyis ni lus brtas par byed cing*/ dgrar gyur pas na nyes pa rnams 'phel bar byed do// de bas na thog mar dus shes pa bya bar ston no// gnyis pa ni gso bar bya ba'i phyir/ lung bstan pa ni/ zas ni skom ni de ltar 'ju bar 'gyur// zhes bya ba mngal nas skyes pa'i sems can de dag ni/ so so'i rgyu kun gzhi rnam par shes pa ma rig pa dang lhag par de la brten pa'i yid gso ba ni srog gi rlung zhes bya ste srid len sred pa'i bag chags mngal du sbyor zhing 'jug ste/ rkyen pha ma'i khu khrag dus tshigs las babs pa'i nad med pa khu ba dang lhan cig gcig tu 'jug pas rkyen byas pa yin te/

dus kyi 'khor lo las kyang*/ lus 'di la ni khams kyi tshogs// ro drug rnams ni bza' btung las// 'byung bzhi 'grub pa'i rkyen byed do// pad+mar tshud pa'i sa bon ni// sa yi 'dzin byed chu yis bskyed// me yi smin byed rlung gis 'phel// nam mkha' go skabs bde ba de// dus las 'di ltar 'grub par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ slob dpon pha gol gyis/ skye ba'i dang po khu khrag nas// dug can srin bu'i dug dang mtshungs// zhes gsungs te/ dper na dug ni srog 'jig pa'i rgyu yin pas/ dug gi 'bu srin 'di skye ba'i rang bzhin 'byung bar snang ngo*// de bzhin du 'di dag ni gnod pa'i rang bzhin yin kyang*/ lhag pa'i nyes pa khu khrag la gnas pas skye ba'i dang po lus 'byung ba'i gnas zhes 'grel pa las kyang 'byung ngo*// khams bzhi po de dag nyes pa ma yin kyang*/ nyon mong pa'i rkyen gyis nye bar 'byung bar byed de/ de yang 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// rlung mkhris bad kan rim par bskyed pa'i rgyu// de la dus gdon zas dang spyod lam bzhi// pags la gram zhing sha la rgyas pa dang*// rtsa la rgyugs shing rus la zhen pa dang*// don la babs shing snod du lhung bar 'gyur// zhes rgyu gsum rkyen bzhi 'jug sgo rnam pa drug tu bka' brgyad pa las gsungs so// dang po nas de ltar du 'byung ba'i rkyen khams dang rnam rtog yin kyang*/ nad stobs su gyur na ni lus 'grub par mi 'gyur/ dri ma rkyen dang ldan pa yis// khu khrag sa bon byed mi nus// zhes gsungs shing*/ ji ltar skyon med pas 'grub pa'i tshul yang*/ khu khrag skyon med par sems can rang las nyon gyis bskul nas/ tshogs pas mngal du chags gyur te// rtsub shing las ni me 'byung mtshungs// sra mo sems kyi mdzes 'gro dang// ma yi kha zas dwangs ma las// rim gyis rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur*// ji ltar nyi ma'i zer gyis me// me shel dang ni 'phrad gyur pa'i// shing la 'gro bar mi snang ste// sems can mngal gnas de dang 'dra// rgyu yi rjes su 'gro bas na// 'bras bu de dang skal mnyam nyid// sems can skye gnas sna tshogs 'dzin// zang ma la sogs bzhus dang mtshungs// de bas khu ba mang ba las// phal cher skyes pa skye 'gyur la// zla mtshan mang ba'i bud med dang*// de gnyis gnyis las ma ning 'gyur// khu khrag rlung gis mang du byed// ci ltar ba las mtshe mar 'gyur// skye gnas mi mthun gzugs mi sdug

/gnod pa'i dri mas skye bar 'gyur// bud med zla ba re re khrag /dwangs ma las byung zhag gsum 'dzag /lo ni bcu gnyis yan chad nas// lnga bcu'i bar 'dzag de nas zad// bud med lo ni bcu drug lon// skyes pa nyi shu lon dang 'dus// mngal nas babs dang khu ba khrag /rlung dang sems ni dag gyur pa'i// bu ni stobs can ldan par skye// de las lo ni ma tshang ba'i// nad can tshe thung skal ngan pa'i// bu chags pa'am chags mi 'gyur// zhes bstan bcos las gsungs te/ ji ltar 'phel ba'i rim pa nas/ skyes pa la ni thug gi bar/ bstan bcos dang bka' brgyad pa'i bshad rgyud chags tshul dag dang ni/ khams dang lus kyi ltos bya ba yin/ sman ni phyi rol gyi khams so// gzhan ni nang gi khams de dag 'dus pa dang 'jig pa la lus zhes bstan pa'i gnod par bya ba dang gnod pa byed par go bar byas te/ de dag gi gzhi ni/ sa dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ rlung dang*/ nam mkha' dang*/ rnam par shes pa'i khams drug po las/ gnod bya lus zungs bdun dri ma dang bcas pa dang*/ gnod byed rlung mkhris bad kan gsum ste/ 'di rnams rgyas par bshad na/ lus zungs dwangs ma khrag dang sha// tshil dang rus rkang khu ba ste// gnod bya bdun yin dri ma gcin// bshang ba rngul la sogs pa'ang yin// zhes slob dpon gyis gsungs te/ de yang phyi rol gyi khams las/ 'byung ba ro drug gi bza' btung gi pho bar me rlung mnyam pa'i rlung gis bzhu/ bad kan myags byed kyis myags par byed/ mkhris pa mdog gyur gyis bsgyur te/ dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa bzhi nas brgyud de mchin par khrag tu gyur nas lus thams cad khyab cing sha dang tshil dang rus dang rkang dang khu bar gyur nas khog dang stobs su byed de/ de dag snyigs ma la mkhris pa dang*/ de la yang mdangs dang snod kyi mkhris pa/ snyigs ni chu'i ku yar byed la/ sha'i snyigs ma ni pags pa dang*/ dri ma tshul gyi snyigs ma ni rmen bu/

rus pa'i snyigs ma ni so sen/ rkang gi snyigs ma ni mchil snabs la sogs pa sbugs kyi dri ma/ khu ba'i snyigs ma ni steng 'og tu 'dzag pa ste/ 'di rnams ni gnod bya'i gzhi lus zung zhes brjod do// 'di rnams kyis dbang po lnga dag skyed do// mig gi dbang po zar ma'i me tog lta bu gzugs can dwangs pa dang*/ rna ba'i dbang po gro kha'i 'dzer bu lta bu dang*/ sna ba'i dbang po zangs ma'i khab gshibs pa lta bu dang*/ lce'i dbang po zla ba'i phyed pa lta bu dang*/ lus kyi dbang po reg 'jam gyi pags pa lta bu dang*/ gzugs can dwangs ma rnams kyis skyed pa dang gnas par byed la/ mi rtag par 'gyur bar byed/ des na dbang po dang khams rnams de dag kyang*/ lo gcig nang gi tshigs tshigs yongs su 'gyur/ ces gsungs pa yin no// nad ji ltar 'gyur ba ni/ dbang po dag ni yongs su gyur pa ni// lus can rnams la sna tshogs nad kyang 'byung*// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// gnod par byed pa ni/ rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan te/ de yang gnas dang byed pa'i khams kyis rnam pa lnga lngar 'gyur te/ bka' brgyad pa las/ nad ni rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan gsum// srog 'dzin gyen rgyu khyab byed me thur sel// 'ju byed mdog bsgyur sgrub mthong mdog sel lnga// rten myag myong tshim 'byor byed bco lnga ste// zhes gsungs pa'i 'dir rgyas par bshad pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ rlung ni srog la sogs pa yi// lnga yi bdag nyid 'dir srog ni// phyir gnas brang dang gre bar gnas// blo dag dbang po sems 'dzin byed// mchil 'dor sgrid 'byung sgrig pa gtor// dbugs rngub zas ni mid par byed// gyen rgyu'i gnas ni brang yin te// sna dang lte bar lkog mar la// tshig 'byin 'bad rtsol dang ma yin// stobs dang kha dog dran las byed// khyab byed snying gnas lus kun la// ma lus khyab cing rab tu mgyogs// 'gro dang ldog dang 'jog pa dang*/

mig 'byed 'dzum pa la sogs pa// lus can bya ba phal cher ni// de dag la ni lus pa yin// gnyam gnas me drod nye bar gnas// nang khrol kun tu rgyu ba yin// bya ba zin pa 'ju ba dang*// dngas snyigs 'byed cing 'dor bar byed// thur sel gzhang mas mdong mo dang*// rkang pa pho mtshan bla na gnas// bya ba khu ba zla mtshan dang*// bshang gci mngal nas 'dzin par byed// mkhris pa'i rang bzhin lnga de la// zhu dang ma zhu ba las gnas// 'byung ba lnga yi bdag nyid kyis// gong ma'i yon tan shas che bas// bsher snyed skam byed 'ju la sogs// las kyi me yi sgrar bshad do// zas ni 'ju dang de bzhin du// dwangs ma snyigs mar 'byed par byed// der gnas bzhin du mkhris pa ni// lhag ma rnams kyi grogs byed pa// stobs bskyed pa yi byed 'gyur pa// de ni 'ju byed ces bshad do// mkhris pa ma zhu'i gnas la brten// mdangs mdog 'gyur ba dmar gyur yin// mkhris pa sgrub byed snying la gnas// glo dang yid gzhung nga rgyal sogs// mngon 'dod don ni sgrub byed pas// mig la gnas te gzugs mthong byed// mthong byed ces ni zhes bshad do// mdog gsal ma ni pags mdog gsal// de nyid pags par gnas pa'o// bad kan rnam lnga brang gnas pa// rang gi stobs kyi sum mdo dang*// snying dang zas kyi mthu dang ni// de nyid la gnas chus byed pas// bad kan lhag ma'i gnas gyur pa'i// rten ni gang yin byed gyur pas// de phyir rten byed ces bshad do// gang zhig ma zhu gnas la gnas// de ni zas sogs 'drul byed pa'i// myag byed ces ni bshad pa yin// myong byed lcer gnas ro tshor byed// bltas byed mgo gnas dbang po ni// tshims par byed do 'byor byed ni// tshigs la gnas nas 'byor bar byed// de ltar nad ni phal po che// mi 'gyur bdag nyid can byas kyang*// gnas par dngas ni shes bya ste// las rnams kyang ni tha dad yin// zhes bya ba ni// rlung mkhris bad kan bco lnga rnams kyi byed las dang bcas pa gsungs nas/

da ni rlung mkhris de nyid kyi mtshan nyid las tsam ste ji ltar nus par 'gyur ba ni/ de la rlung ni rtsub shing yang*/ grang zhing phra ba sra zhing g.yo/ de ma zhes bya ba ni nges par bzung ste/ nyes pa de rnams kyis rlung rtsub pa dang*/ yang ba dang*/ grang ba dang*/ sra ba dang*/ phra ba dang*/ rtsa sbugs las 'jug pa dang*/ g.yo ba'i ngang tshul can las mi gnas pa yin/ dris pa gzigs can la sogs pa ni/ rlung grang ba dang dro ba ma yin par bshad la/ 'dir yang zung du 'jug pa'i rjes su bas/ grang ba dang dro ba gnyis ka ma yin par 'dod do// de yang zung du 'jug pa g.yo ba/ yang dag sbyor ba don gnyis byed/ nyi mar ldan pas bsreg par byed// zla bar ldan pas bsil bar byed/ zhes bstan pa de bzhin du/ rlung ni zung du 'jug pas na// bad kan ldan pa'i bsil bar 'gyur// mkhris pa ldan pa'i tsha ba yin// zhes bshad pa yin no zhe na/ 'dir lan brjod par bya ste/ rlung grang ba dang dro ba ni bden mod kyis/ de zung du 'jug pa yin yang de tsam gyis dro bas grang ba'i ngo bo nyid med par mi 'gyur ro// rlung gi mtshan nyid grang ba yin par bshad pa'i dgos pa ni 'di yin no// 'di la dro ba nyes par 'gyur/ zhes bstan pa'i phyir smos pa yin no// mkhris snum dang bcas rno zhing bro// yang zhing dri snam 'khru zhing bsher// zhes bya ba las/ snum bcas zhes bya ba ni cung zad snum pa ste/ ces pa'i sgra ni cung zad tsam gyi ston te/ dper na kha ba dang bcas pa'i sha kha ra zer ba ltar cung zad snum bag can gang yin pa de ni snub bag can zhes bya'o// rno ba ni kha 'big pa ltar myur du byed pas te/ dman pa las go log pa'o// dro ba ni tsha 'ur 'ur skyed pa'o// dri snam pa ni nya rul ba'i dri bsnam pa lta bu'o// 'khru ba ni bshang ba sla ba'i steng dang 'og tu khyab cing rgyu ba bstan pa'i ma yin no// bsher na ni sla'o// bad kan snum bsil lci ba dang*/

btum zhing 'jam bstan 'byar bag zhes bya ba ni snum pa'i yon tan sa snum pa'o// bsil ba ni tsha ba med pa'o// lci ba ni yang ba med par 'gyur la/ btul ba ni yun ring zhig nas ldang ba'o// 'jam pa ni mi rtsub pa'o// bstan pa khyab pa'i ngang tshul can no// 'byar bag can ni sor mo la chags shing 'jam bag nam so la 'cher bag can no// de ltar yon tan de dang ldan pas yon tan tha mi dad pa'i nye bar gnas pa'i rlung la sogs par yon tan nyid du bshad do// 'di rnams rang sor gnas pa ni nad med 'gyur zhing*/ 'dres pa dang ni 'khrugs pa dang*/ zad cing stong pa las tshor ba'i sdug bsngal skyed pa nad ces bshad do// slob dpon gyis/ de nyid gnyis gsum zad 'khrugs las/ ldan pa dang ni 'dus pa yin/ zhes gsungs te/ 'dir smras pa/ mkhris pa'i gnas su rlung zhugs pas// tsha ba rlung gnyis ldan par 'gyur// bad kan gnas su rlung zhugs pas// bad rlung ldan pa zhes byar 'gyur// rlung ni lhag pa zhes brjod de// bad rlung gnyis la mkhris pa'o// mkhris rlung gnas su bad kan rgyas// rang zad gzhan 'phel zhes brjod de// de phyir ldan pa rnams drug ste// 'dus pa gsum du 'gyur ba yin// dgu po 'phel dang zad pa yis// bco brgyad dag tu 'gyur ba de// bye brag rnam pa bco lnga la// 'phel zad sum cu tham pa yod// de dag gnod byed rang bzhin te// gnod byed bdun dang dri lnga// 'phel zad nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste// kun la bdun cu don gnyis yod// 'di dag gnas gyur ma gyur bas// lus 'di gnas dang 'joms par byed// zhes bya ba ni 'phel zad bdun cu rtsa gnyis bstan no// de ltar gnod bya dang gnod byed kyi rang bzhin bshad nas/ de dag gi rgyas par bshad pa ni bzhi ste/ lus zungs kyi ldang tshad dang*/ 'brel pa rtsa'i gnas lugs dang*/ gnyan pa gnad kyi gnas dang*/ rgyu lam bu ga'i gnas lugs so// 'di rnams kyang bshad pa'i rgyud las/

dang po rlung gi ldang tshad lgang phug gang*// mkhris pa'i ldang tshad rang gi gsang sgro gang*// bad kan ldang tshad rang gi snyim pa gsum// khrag dang phyi sa'i ldang tshad snyim pa bdun// gcin dang chu ser ldang tshad snyim pa bzhi// zhag dang tshil bu'i ldang tshad snyim pa do// mdangs dang khu ba'i ldang tshad khyor ba re// klad pa'i ldang tshad rang gi snyim pa gang*// sha yi ldang tshad spar tshad lnga brgya ste// bud med bla dang nu ma nyi shus lhag /rus pa ldang tshad rus rigs nyi shu gsum// de la rgyal tshigs 'phang lo nyi shu brgyad// rtsib ma'i grangs ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste// so yi grangs ni sum cu rtsa gnyis mchis// rus pa'i dum bu sum brgya drug cu ste// yan lag tshigs chen rnam pa bcu gnyis yod// tshigs phran nyis brgya dang ni lnga bcu'o// chu ba bcu drug rgyus pa dgu brgya mchis// skra yi nyag ma nyi khri chig stong dang*// ba spu'i bu ga bye ba sa ya mchis// don lnga snod drug bu ga sgo dgu yod// 'dzam gling rang lus 'dom gang gru bzhi ste// gzugs ngan rnams la rang khru phyed dang bzhi// 'brel ba rtsa yi gnas lugs bstan pa ni// chags srid 'brel pa tshe yi rtsa dang bzhi// chags pa'i rtsa ni lte ba las gyes gsum// rtsa gcig gyen la song bas klad pa chags// gti mug klad par brten nas gnas pa ste// de las bad kan skyed pas stod na gnas// rtsa gcig bar du zug pas srog rtsa chags// zhe sdang srog rtsa khrag la brten nas chags// de las mkhris pa skyed pas bar na gnas// rtsa gcig mthur du zug pas gsang bar chags// 'dod chags pho mo'i gsang bar gnas pa ste// de la rlung skyed smad na gnas pa yin// srid pa'i rtsa bo che ni rnam bzhi ste// dbang po yul la 'char bar byed pa yis// klad pa la srid rtsa phran lnga brgyas skor// dran pa'i dbang po gsal bar byed pa'i rtsa// snying la srid de rtsa phran lnga brgyas bskor// lus kyi phung po chags par byed pa'i rtsa// lte ba la srid rtsa phran lnga brgyas bskor// bu tsha rigs rgyud 'phel bar byed pa'i rtsa// mtshan ma la srid rtsa phran lnga brgyas bskor// steng 'og thad kar lus kun rjes su 'dzin// 'brel ba'i rtsa la dkar nag gnyis yod de// sgrod pa rtsa ni rtsa yi sdong po la// yal ga'i tshul du gyen la gyes pa yis// sha khrag 'phel byed rtsa chen nyi shu bzhi// don snod nang 'brel sbas pa'i rtsa chen brgyad// yan lag phyir 'brel mngon pa'i rtsa bcu drug

/de las gyes pa'i gtar rtsa bdun cu bdun// gnyan pa'i rtsa nad brgya dang bcu gnyis yod// 'brel pa'i rtsa phran brgya dang brgyad cu dgu// de la phyi nang bar gsum brgya nyi shu// rtsa phran sum brgya drug cur gyes pa yin// de las rtsa phran bdun brgya dag tu gyes// de las yang phran lus la drwa bar 'brel// klad pa rtsa yi rgya mtsho chen po las// rtsa ba lta bur thur du zug pa yis// bya ba byed pa'i chu rtsa bcu dgu yod// de la don snod nang 'brel rtsa chen brgyad// dar gyi dpyang thag bcu gsum sbas pa'i rtsa// yan lag phyir 'brel mngon pa'i rtsa bcu drug /de la chu rtsa phran bu bcu drug gyes// mi la tshe yi rtsa ni gsum gnas yod// gcig ni mgo lus thams cad khyab par gnas// gcig ni dbugs dang 'grogs nas rgyu ba yin// gcig ni bla dang 'dra ste 'khyams pa yin// rlung khrag rgyu ba'i bu ga phyi nang kun// 'brel byas lus ni bskyed cing gnas pa dang*// srog gi rtsa ba yin phyir rtsa zhes brjod// gnyan pa'i gnad la sha tshil rus pa dang*// chu rgyus don snod rtsa yi gnad dang bdun// sha gnad skrangs shing rus gnad zug gzer che// chu rgyus gnad kyis 'ja' bar byed pa de// rtsa tshil don snod gnad kyis srog 'dor byed// 'chi sbyong 'tsho ba dka' phyir gnad ces bya// sha gnad bzhi bcu tham pa tshim gnad brgyad// rgyus pa'i gnad ni sum cu rtsa gnyis te// rgyu gnad brgya dang bcu gsum dang*// rtsa gnad brgya dang dgu bcu tham pa yod// mgo la re gnyis ske la so gsum gnas// dgu bcu go lnga byang khog stod smad gnas// brgya dang bzhi ni yan lag bzhi la gnas// gnad kyi rnam grangs sum brgya rtsa gnyis bshad// de la rab tu gnyan pa dgu bcu drug /chod zin srog 'dor mkhas kyang bcos su med// 'bring la gnyan pa bzhi bcu rtsa dgu bshad// mkhas pa rnams kyis bcos su btub pa yin// de las lhag pa gnad du bstan na yang*// gnyan par ma bshad kun gyis gso bar nus// rgyu lam bu ga'i gnas lugs phyi nang gnyis// nang gi bu ga srog zungs dri ma gsum// chu dang zas rgyu phyi nang gnas pa yin// phyi yi bu ga mgor bdun gsang bar gnyis// bud med mngal sgo nu ma gnyis kyis lhag

/dbyibs zlum sbom dang phra la ring bar 'brel// lo ma rgyan gyi rtsa ltar gnas pa'o// dwangs ma nyer 'phel sgo ni bu ga ste// zas dang spyod lam mi mthun bsten pa yis// bu ga'i rgyu lam gnod pas nad bskyed la// mang 'byung 'gag dang gzhan 'gro 'khrugs par byed// gnod med bu ga dag pas bde bar 'gyur// ces gsungs so// de dag gnod par bya ba dang*/ gnod par byed pa rnams bstan nas/ de nyid kyang 'chos pa dang gso bar byed pas sman pas ci ltar gnas par bya ba ni/ de nyid la ni sman pas zla gsum bzhi// tshigs kyi bar dang dus drug rnams dang ni// khams drug mkhas pas bya ba shes par bya// zas skom sman rnams go rim ji bzhin te// zhes gsungs pas/ sman pa ni sman gyi rig byed brgyad shes dgos la/ ro'i khams drug la mkhas par bya ba ni/ slob dpon gyis tshigs su bcad pa gsum gsungs pa'i dngos ni/ ro ni mngar skyur lan tsha dang*// tsha ba kha ba ska bas te// rdzas drug la gnas de dag kyang*// go rim bzhin du stobs chen yin// zhes gsungs te/ mngar ba la sogs pa'i ro drug ni/ lce yi dbang po'i yul yin pas na ro'o// de dag kyang 'byung ba lnga'i bdag nyid can rnams kyi stobs shin tu bskyed pa yin la/ go rim bzhin du mthu stobs che ba la/ sngon ma rnams stobs thob ci nus che ba yin no// de bas ro thams cad pas ro mngar ba ni/ lus can rnams kyi stobs shin tu bskyed pa yin la/ ska bas ni thams cad la stobs bskyed pa dman pa yin no// de la mngar bzhin du bu ram dang mar la sogs ro sdebs pa rnams so// skyur ba ni skyur rtsi chen po la sogs shin tu skyur bar byed pa yin no// lan tsha ba ni lce myang tsha la sogs pa yin no// tsha ba ni na le sham la sogs pa'o// kha ba ni nim pa la sogs pa'o// ska ba ni a ru la sogs pa'o// drug po ces bya ba ni/ drug po nyid lhag pa'am/

chad pa ma yin no// ro de rnams kyi yon tan dang*/ ro la sogs pa'i bye brag dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar zhing 'dres pa dang*/ ro rjes nyid dang*/ shin tu myur bar brtags pa la sogs kyi dbang gis tha dad par zin du gyur kyang*/ 'on kyang drug po nyid la sogs 'da' bar mi 'gyur ro// de las dang po'i gsum pa ni/ rlung 'joms tsha sogs bad kan sel// ska dang kha dang mngar bas ni// mkhris sel gzhan dag byed pa yin/ zhes bya ba ni/ de la ro rnams kyi nang nas dang po gsum ni/ mngar skyur lan tsha rnams kyis rlung 'joms shing zhi bar byed pa'o// gzhan dag tsha ba dang ska ba gsum ni/ rlung de nyid skyed par byed cing 'khrugs par byed pa'o// tsha sogs bad kan sel byed cing*// ces bya ba ni/ tsha ba dang ska ba dang kha ba gsum ni bad kan sel la/ mngar ba dang skyur ba dang lan tsha gsum ni bad kan skyed pa yin no// ska ba dang kha ba dang ni gnod pa nas dri ma'i mthar thug gi tshad dang ldan par gnas pa ni mnyam par 'jug cing tha mal par gnas pa ste/ de la phan pa'i rdzas gang yin pa de ni/ tha mal gnas la phan zhes bya ba ste/ de'i dus su dpyad pa ma rten pa'i skabs 'og nas 'chad pa bzhin du yin no// de'i nus pa bshad pa ni/ de la tsha bsil phul 'khru byung bas nus pa rnam pa gnyis su bshad/ ces gsungs te/ de la zhes pa rdzas de nus pa nyi shu yod pa'i nang nas tsha ba dang bsil ba dag ni phul du byung ba yin/ nus pa zhes bya ste tshe'i rig byed thams cad las tsha ba dang bsil ba gnyis po'i nus pa bshad pa ni/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i don yin no// de la nus pa ni/ yon tan bdun du bya la/ tsha ba dang bsil ba phul du byung ba ni khyad par du 'phags pa nyid do// la las ni tsha ba'i nus pa phul du byung ba tsha ba'i nus pa mi thob la/ de bzhin du bsil ba'i nus pa phul du byung zhing bsil ba'i nus khyad du rgyu bsil ba'i ming thob bo// gal te rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs pa yod mod kyi/

'on kyang 'gro ba ni me dang zla ba'i bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir nus pa rnam gnyis kho nar bshad do// sman zhu ba'i rjes bshad pa ni/ rdzas kyi zhu ba rnam gsum ste// mngar skyur tsha ba'i bdag nyid can// ces gsungs te/ zhu ba ni rnam pa gsum yod la/ rdzas thams cad yongs su zhu ba'i dus su 'bru la la rjes dpag bar bya rje/ pho ba'i me dang 'phrad pa las// ro rnams rang gi rang bzhin las// gzhan du gyur pa de la ni// rnam pa gsum nyid yod kyi drug /yod kyang drug ni ma yin no// de las rdzas la la ni mngar bar zhu/ la la ni tsha bar zhu ba yin no// de la mngar ba dang lan tsha ni mngar bar zhu'o// skyur ba ni skyur ba'o// tsha ba dang ska ba dang kha ba ni tsha ba'o// de ni 'bru las dpag pa yin/ de yang pho ba'i me las 'phrad pa las// gzhan zhig ro ni gzhan gyur la// ro rnams zhu ba'i tha ma dag /ro ni zhu ba zhes bshad do// zhes 'byung ba yin no// de bas na khyad du smin par gyur pa la zhu rjes zhes bya'i cung zad smin pa ni min no// de bzhin mtho tshul drang srong tsa ra ka las kyang*/ rdzas kyi ro ni 'bab pa na// las kyi mtha' ni zhu ba yin// ji srid gnas pa'i yon tan de// gus pa la ni shes par 'gyur// zhes bshad pa yin no// de ltar na las byas pa'i rjes su dpag pa'i tshul gcig pa'i gnas skabs pho ba'i me dang 'phrad pa las/ ro gzhan du 'gyur ba gang yin pa de nyid du zhu ba zhes bya'o// gang pho ba'i me dang 'phrad pa tsam gyis ro rnams gnas skabs du mar 'gyur te/ dang po ni ro mngar ba'o// de'i rjes thog de nyid smin pa na skyur ba'o// de las kyang smin pa'i mthar thug na tsha bar 'gyur ro// da ni ro drug po de'i yon tan bshad par bya/ yon tan lci rtul bsil dang snum// 'jam dang ska ba mnyen dang bstan// grang dang bcas shing ska bag can// de bzlog pa dang nyi shu yin// zhes pa ro drug yon tan lci ba la sogs pa bcu yin no// de la bzlog pa dang nyi shu yin pas shes par bya ste/

'di dag rims kyi bzlog pa yin/ yang ba dang rno ba dang tsha ba dang rtsub pa dang sla ba dang bsre ba dang g.yo ba dang sbom pa dang bla bag gam nal po yin no// mngar bas ni mkhris pa sel/ skyur ba dang lan tsha dang tsha bas mkhris pa de nyid skyed do// lan tshas ni rlung sel cing bad kan mkhris pa skyed pa yin no// ro rnams kyi rten rdzas rnam pa gsum yod par bshad pa ni/ de ltar rdzas ni rnam pa gsum// zhi 'khrugs tha mal gnas la phan// zhes gsungs pa yin te/ de ltar zhes pa tshul zhi ba la sogs pa'i dbye ba rnam pa gsum du 'gyur ba yin gyis/ rnam pa gzhan gyis ni gnyis sam yang na rnam pa du ma nyid do// zhes de ltar gyi sgra rnam pas bshad pa yin no// de la gang 'khrugs pa de zhi bar 'gyur bas zhi ba ste/ dper na til mar dang*/ mar dang sbrang rtsi lta bu ste/ de la til ni snum pa dang*/ bro ba dang ldan pas rlung de nyid dang mi mthun pa'i mtshan nyid zhi bar byed pa yin pas/ mar gsar ni mngar ba dang*/ sil ba dang brtan pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas/ de dag mi mthun pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pas mkhris pa sel ba yin no// sbrang rtsi snum pa dang*/ rno ba dang*/ ska ba dang ldan pas de dang mi mthun pa'i mtshan nyid can/ bad kan zhi bar byed pa yin no// de la 'khrugs pa ni/ gang rlung la sogs pa'i gnod pa rnams dang bcud kyi dwangs ma la sogs pa 'i lus zungs rnams dang*/ gcin la sogs pa'i dri ma 'khrugs pas ni 'khrugs pa'o// de dag ni dper na nas thug dang*/ sa to la dang*/ ma sha dang*/ nya sha dang*/ mdog dgu slon pa dang*/ nyungs dkar dang*/ zho gsar pa dang*/ grum dang*/ mi mthun pa'i zas nya dang 'o ma lhan cig bza' ba lta bu'o// tha mal par gnas pa la phan pa de ltar go bzlog ni de dag yin pas spyir nyi shu'o// de ltar ro dang nus pa dang yon tan spyir gnas/ da ni zas skom la sogs kyi bye brag cung zad bshad par bya ste// thams cad kyi gzhi chu bstan pa ni/

mkha' las babs pa gang ga'i chu// 'tsho byed ngom byed yid khar 'ong*// tshim zhing sems ni gsal byed la// sla zhing ro mi gsal la zhim// bsil zhing yang la dri ma zhim// bsil zhing yang la bdud rtsir mtshungs// zhes pa yan lag brgyad ldan no// nyi zla rlung gis reg gyur pa// de ni yul dus la ltos nas// phal cher phan dang gnod pa min// gang zhig char babs dri ma med// 'bras can dngul phor nang gnas pa// ma rul mdog kyang ma 'gyur ba// gaṅgā'i chu de btung bar bya// gzhan du 'tsho chu ston zla ni// 'bring po min par btung mi bya// char pa'i chu ni snod bzang bzhag /'gyur ba med par rtag tu btung*// de med na ni thang la gnas// bar snang ba dang rjes mthun yin// sa phyogs dkar nag gtsang zhing yang*// nyi 'od rlung gis 'phog pa bsngags// de rnams bzang ba'i rang bzhin no// steng ka 'dam rdzab nya lcibs dang*/ rtsa dang lo ma snyogs ma can// nyi zla rlung gis ma 'phogs pa// sngon du babs dang chu gar lci// lbu ba srog chags can dang dro// grang ches po yi mi bzod par// char gang dus su ma 'bab dang*// dus kyi dang po babs pa gang*// srog chags dug dang ba btsog 'dres// bshang lci dug 'dres snod mi btung*// de rnams nang pa 'dres rnams ni// nub phyogs nas ni rgya mtshor 'bab// gang yang myur bab rdul med chu// de ni 'dor ni dge ba yin// de la bzlog na bzang ba yin// rdo la shugs drag rdeb pa yis// rgyun chad g.yos pa'i chu dag dang*// gangs can ma la ya nas byung*// dge 'o 'di ni gtan 'thung na// srin 'bu rkang 'bam snying nad dang*// skog ma klad pa'i nad bskyed 'gyur// shar dang nub kyi mtha' las byung*// gzhang 'brum skye ste dbang chen 'bab// dmu rdzing rkang 'bam gzer nad skye// sa cha byin da'i ri la 'bab// mdze dang skya rbab klad nad 'gyur// pa ṭi pa ṭas nad kun skye// khron pa rdzing las gsog pa'i chu// skam sa rlan can brag las skye// drod chung skran yod skya rbab dang*// dmu rdzing tshad 'khru zhang 'brum dang*// pho ba'i drod chung 'or nad can// mi btung snag skas nyung zad btung*// ston ka sos ka ma gtogs pa// nad med pas kyang cung zad btung*// zas zos bar mtha' thog mar ni// chu 'thung ran dang sbom skem 'gyur// chu bsil chang nad brkyal ba dang*// skyug dang ngal dang mgo 'khor dang*// skom dang lus cha mkhris pa dang*// khrag rgyas dug gi bsil byed yin// chu bskol drod skyes zas 'ju zhing*// mgul bde lus yang gcin nad sel// skyegs bu rlung nad lto sbos bad kan dang*// rims gsar 'phral du bzlog byed cing*// lud pa cham gsar dbugs mi bde// rtsibs logs zug la bsngags pa yin// chu ni bskol la grang pa dag

/bad kan mi skye lus yang zhing*// mkhris pa can la bsngags pa yin// de ni zhag lon nyes gsum bskyed// rgya ltar chu ni snum pa dang*// ro mngar ro btsa' bsil zhing yang*// skom dang mkhris pa rlung nad sel// drod skyed pa yi nad sbyong byed// dbyar ni char dang chu bo'i chu// mchog tu bzang dang ngan par bshad// chu'i sde tshan no/ 'o ma phal cher zhu rjes mngar// snum zhing mdangs skyed lus zung 'phel// rlung dang mkhris sel ro btsa' byed// bad kan 'phel zhing bsil ba yin// ba yi 'o ma 'tsho byed yin// bcud kyi len cing glo rdol dang*// glo gcong la phan yid gzhung byed// ma he'i 'o ma 'ju grags dang*// gnyid med la phan rab lci bsil// ra yi 'o ma kha zhing tsha// khrag dang mkhris pa tshad nad sel// rnga mong 'o ma cung rtsub dro// lan tsha bro zhing drod che yang*// rlung dang bad kan lto sbos srin// 'or nad dmu rdzing gzhang nad sel// bud med nu zho'i rlung mkhris khrag /snad pa'i mig nad sel byed do// tshim byed mig dang snar blug phan// lug gi 'o ma snying gnod tsha// rlung 'joms mkhris pa bad kan skye// ba glang mo yi rab stan byed// rmig pa gcig pas mtsho rmongs byed// 'o rlon bad kan skyed cing lci// bzhos ma thog bro bdud rtsi mtshungs// zho ni ro dang zhu rjes skyur// yi kha 'byed cing kha zas len// zho bran dpyid dang sos ka dang*// ston du mtshan mo btung mi bya// dar gsar yang la ska zhing skyur// drod skye bad kan rlung dag sel// de 'dra zho kha chu 'dra yang*// rtsa sbug sbyong la rtug 'gag sel// 'phral gyi mar gsar ro btsa' zhing*// zhun mar stobs ni stong dang ldan// sbyor ba las ni las byed 'gyur// mar rnying gis kyang nad rnams sel// khrum gsar spri dang rgya khrum dang*// chur ba la sogs stobs bskyed cing*// khu ba nyid dang bad kan 'phel// 'o ma'i sde tshan no// bu ram shing khus 'khru lci snum// sel zhing khrag mkhris sel ba ste// rtsir zhing yun ring drod du 'gyur// hag dang khan dha ka ra khad// rim pas yon tan che ba ste// khrag dang rlung ni sel ba yin// sbrang rtsi rtsub cing ska la mngar// sna tshogs nus pa can du 'gyur// ra yi mar dang rta ni mtshungs// nad rnams thams cad sel bar byed// e ran mar ni tsha zhing kha// stod nad smug 'or rlig blug sel// yungs kar tsha bro bad rlung sel// ba ru ra mar mngar zhing lci// skra skyed rlung dang mkhris pa sel// nim mar rab tu tsha min kha// 'o bris mkhris pa bad kan sel// zar ma le rgan rtsi yi mar// dro zhing pags nad bad mkhris sel// zhag dang rkang gis rlung 'joms shing*// stobs dang khu ba bad kan skyed// sha ni ro yi rjes mthun la// tshil yang de dang 'dra zhes bya// snum pa'i sde tshan no// 'bru chang drod ldan yid kha 'byed// rlung dang bad kan sel ba yin// chang gsar lci zhing nyes gsum skyed// chang rnying de las gzhan du byed// rim par nyung gtong btung bar bya// chang dang yid 'ong rno ba dang*// ba ru'i chang gis yang zhing phan// sman chang yon tan kun skyed byed// rgun chang nad dang sbyong la phan// bu ram chang dro rtug 'gag sel// bur shing las byas rlung mkhris skyed// sbrang chang gcin nad cham pa sel// yun ring gyur pa'i chang tsha ni// rno rtsub yid kha 'byed cing 'khru// 'bras bu rang skyur 'khru rno tsha// sna tshogs 'bras bu'i sman gyi chang*// so so'i nus pa ji bzhin no// ba gcin ra lug ma he dang*// glang po rta bong rnga mo'i gcin// mkhris skyed rtsub cing rno la tsha// srin nad 'or dang dmu rdzing sbos// skya rbab bad rlung mdze nad 'joms// dri chu'i nad rnams phal cher 'joms// sman chang gi sde tshan no// da ni bza' ba'i sde tshan bshad par bya'o// rtsa snar 'bras chen la sogs pa'i// 'bras ni bzang po bcu gsum yod// ro mngar zhu rjes mngar zhing bsil// 'bras gzhan mngar zhing zhu rjes skyur// mkhris pa skyed cing kha dang tsha// sa la'i 'bras ni nyes gsum skyed// ci rtse tshe dang nyi ba ra// khri rgod rgo 'bras btsong bsil yang*// rtsa 'bru de dag rlung skyed cing*// kha rtsub bad kan mkhris pa sel// de la khre ni ltas byed cing*// lus kyi chag grung sbyor bar byed// khro rgod mchog tu 'khru gcod cing*// dog na bsil la dug sel yin// nas ni rtsub bsil lci la mngar// ro btsa' rten byed bad kan sel// nas rgod cung zad dman pa yin// snyug ma'i 'bru ni rtsub cing tsha// bro ba mngar snum bro la bsil// nan ta'i 'bru yi blo ska zhing*// bsil zhing mngar yang bad kan sel// mo sran mung ka sran chung sogs// gang bu can 'bru rtsa sgo 'gags// ro ska mngar zhing 'khru ba gcod// zhu rjes tsha la bsil zhing yang*// 'di las mud ka rlung chung zhing*// mon sran dkar po rlung bskyed yin// rgya tsha sran nag zhu rjes skyur// til 'bru dro zhing stobs skyed la// zar ma le rgan rtsi dmar snum// lci zhing bad mkhris skyed pa yin// sa la yun ring yun thung ste// 'ju dka' lo lon rim bzhin yang*// 'bru yi sde tshan no// sha yi sde tshan sha brgyad te/

sha rkyang la sogs ri dwags dang*/ 'bru zan mchu bsko bya yi sde// sbrul sogs khung na gnas pa dang*// gcan gzan khra sogs rtsal mthu bzang*// phag rgod g.yag rgod chen po'i sde// chu gnas bya yi sde tshan dang*// de bzhin nya sogs chur gnas pas// ra lug la sogs g.yung gi sde// ri dwags rnams ni cung zad bsil// gnyis pa'i nang nas rgya bya mchog /'dus pa sel ba'i dam pa yin// gzhan dag 'bring dang dman pa ste// rma bya thi ba nyes gsum bskyed// gsum pa tha dad nus par ldan// rtsal mthus bza' ba'i sha rnams ni// yang zhing tsha bro zhu rjes tsha// lnga pa chen po'i sde tshan rnams// drod che nus pa so so yin// chur gnas phal cher mkhris pa sel// bsil zhing yang dang bcas pa yin// chu gnas za ti mchog yin te// rtsi li rtsi ma nyes gsum skyed// ra sha yang zhing snyoms pas te// lug sha lci zhing lus brtas byed// ma he'i sha ni lci zhing tsha// phag pa'i sha ni bad kan bskyed// ba glang sha ni snyoms pas te// rta bong drod che phag sha bsil// so so'i lus la dpag med lci// lus gcig la yang nus pa ni// du ma yod kyang 'dir ma bshad// sha ni 'phral bsad dag pa dang*// dar la babs pa brten par bya// rang shi rid dang shin tu 'tsho// nad chu dug gis shi ba spangs// pho dang mo yi stod smad phyed// ces reg sbrum ma thams cad lci// rkang bzhi mo yin thams cad lci// bya rnams kyi ni pho yin yang*// mgo bo ro stod brang dang rgyab// rked pa spyi yi lci ba yin// de bzhin pho ba rgyu ma sogs// go rim bzhin du lci ba yin// khrag la sogs pa'i lus kyi zungs// phyi ma phyi ma lci ba yin// sha las rlig pa pho mtshan dang*// mkhal ma pho ba gzhang dag lci// sha'i sde tshan no// phan tshun g.yos su byas pa dang*// tshod ma rnams kyi sde tshan la// phan tshun sbyar bar gyur pa yin// ro dang nus pa zhu rjes kun// phan tshun gyur bar byed pa ste// mkhas pas legs par rten de dpyad// sna tshogs bza' btung mod rnams dang*// so so'i ro nus dpag med kyang*// ming gi bsdus pa la bshad cing*// de ltar rdzas kyi nus pa thams cad kyang sman pa rnams kyi so sor rtogs par byas nas/

na so yul dus kyi dbang gis so sor dang mthun par 'gyur ba rnams dang*// lhag pa'i dus na zhi bar byed pa'i gnyen po dang de stong pa dang 'di nyid 'phel bar byed pa rnams rten par bya'o// de'i phyir na dus dang dus ster sten par bya'o// bshad pa ni/ rlung shas che ba'i nad ni dbyar na ldang*// ston du gyur pa na ni mkhris pa g.yo// dgun gyi dus su de bzhin 'dus pa ste// bad kan shas che'i nad ni dpyid ldang ngo*// zhes gsung ste/ de'i dus de dag tu nad ldang ba zhes pa ni/ phyir 'phel ba yin pas/ de dag gi gnyen po zas dang sman yang de nyid zhi bar byed pa brten par bya'o// rgas pa rlung mi dar ma mkhris pa'i mi// byis pa bad kan mi yin na sos nyan// zhes tshe lo brgya pa nas lo sum cu rtsa gsum gyi dus de dag tu 'gyur la/ 'dir lo bcu gnyis ni byis pa'i dus so// nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni dar ma'o// de nyid bsdoms pa'i lo brgya sum cu so drug phan chad rgan pa'i rnam par 'gyur ro// drug cu las lhag pa phan chad rgan po zhes bya'o// de bzhin du yul yang*/ ngar can grang ba rlung gi yul yin te// skam sa tshad gdung che ba mkhris pa'i yul// rlan can snum pa bad kan yul du bshad// ces bka' ba brgyad pa las byung ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis kyang*/ skam sa phal cher rlung skyed cing*// rlan can phal cher bad kan skyed// cha mnyam nyes pa mnyam pa ste// sa yi phyogs ni gsum du bshad// ces bya ba yang*/ sa phyogs ni rnam pa gsum du bshad do// de la skam sa ni chu dang shing dang ri bo cung zad gcig yod pa de 'og nas 'chad do// phal cher rlung skyed cing zhes bya ba ni/ de las bskyed pa'i nad ni rtsub pa dang*/ sra ba yin pa dang*/ ri dwags la sogs pa yang rlung gi shas che ba yin no// rlan yang chu dang shing rdo sa dang*/ rlung med pa dang than pa nyung ba'o// de ni bad kan 'phel ba yin te/

de las skyes pa'i sman la sogs pa yang*/ snum la sogs pa yang ldan pa yin no// cha mnyam pa ni mtshan nyid gang dang ldan pa de dang 'dres pa'i tshul yin no// nyes pa mnyam ste zhes pa ni/ rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa mnyam pa'o// de ltar sa'i phyogs ni gsum gnas so// de dag gi dus su zas dang sman ro gang dang ldan pa dpyad par gsungs pas/ dbyar ni snum mkhregs lan tsha skyur ba'i ro// ston ni mngar dang snum dang bsil ba'o// dgun ni mngar dang skyur bas te/ dpyid kyi dus su rtsub dro tsha ba'o/ zhes sngar bstan pa'i ro dang nus pa dang zhu rjes de dag dang ldan pas/ nad lhag pa de dag 'joms par byed do// des na 'di la 'phros nas kha zas kyi tshul gsungs ba dang*/ dug tu gyur pa gsungs shing*/ brtag pa'i le'u slob dpon gyis gsungs pa/ 'bras can dug can gsher bag can// skam pa can du 'dra bar 'gyur// yun ring tshos pa'i 'gyur ba dang*// tshos pa'i zhag lon lta bur 'gyur// du ba rma bya'i mgrin 'dra zhing*// khong nyos rgyal dang lus rngul byed// dri dang mdog btsog nyams par 'gyur// dul rtsi rma bya'i sgro ltar 'tsher// tshod ma myur du skam pa dang*// skam pa'i mdog ni rnag gyur lcang*// der gzugs che ba'i chung ba'am// mi sdug pa'am mi snang 'gyur// du ma steng 'byung ri mo 'tshams// kha chu 'dra dang chu sbur 'gyur// btung ba mngar ba'i skyur tshod ma// sha dag 'tshams byed ro dang bral// sha khur ri mo sngor snang zhing*// 'o ma zangs mdog zho dri ma// dar ba la ni ser dang nag /mar khu chu dang 'dra bar snang*// chang dang chu rnag sbrang rtsi la// ljang nag til mar dag las dmar// shing tog ma smin smin par snang*// smin pa dag ni yongs su 'drul// kha zas rlon dang skam pa dag /rnying dang mdog ni nyams par 'gyur// rnying pa dag ni sra ba dag /de dag kho nar bzlog par 'gyur// me tog 'phreng rtsi lo ma 'gags// snyid cing dri ni mi zhim 'gyur// gos la nag
