so brtse la// ro mi tshor la 'gram so tham// de la nad kun 'joms sman dang*// ur tsir rtsogs khus phur rkang sdebs// ma zhus gnas babs rngul ba dang*// rgyal shing lto sbos myos mgo 'khor// ba spu ldang zhing skyugs lus tsha// mig mi gsal zhing snying mi dran// yan lag thig les khyab par 'gyur// zhu ba'i gnas su phyin na yang*// kha dog sna tshogs khyab pa dang*// sa cing mang du 'khu bar 'gyur// snya skom skem zhing mdog skya la// sub la skye zhing nyams stobs zab// de nyid rlon dang khrus byas nas// sor gnyis bu ram skol zhing*// srin bu ba ri shi ka dang*// dam du la'i rtsa ba dang*// rgya snag sgong nga bal bu za// snar btang mig sman blug bya ba// dug gzhi'i phyir ni sbyang bar bya// dug 'thung pa dag steng dang ni// de bzhin 'og gi sbyangs gyur na// dus su bzang zangs brdar phye la// sbrang rtsir bcas pa snying gcong 'byin// snying nas sbyangs shing gser phye ni// zhib mo zho gcig byin byas na// pad+ma'i 'dab mar chu bzhin du// gser gyi yan lag la mi chags// tshe yang ring du 'phel bar 'gyur// kha zas dag kyang ma mthun zos// sbyar dug 'dra bar shes par bya// rlan can sha dang mo sran dre'u// sbrang rtsi lo 'o myu gu bcas// pad+ma'i rtsa ba la phug gam// bu ram dang bcas mi 'phrod yin// khyad par du ni lo ma nya// nya rnams las kyang rtsi mi ma// 'o ma lhan cig skyur kun ni// mi 'phrod shing thog de bzhin no// de bzhin rgya sran khre dag dang*// khal ma ku mu ta mi 'phrod// la phug la sogs sngo dang ni// zos na 'o ma spangs bar bya// phag rgod byi gtur sha mi za// khyim bya sri sha ra zhor min// sha rlon mkhris pa dag dang ni// la phug ma sha'i tshos mar min// le rgan rtsi tshod lug shar min// mi'u'i tshod ma sa tshar min// na sha'i sran tshod tha ram zho// yar ngo mi gu tha tsha 'bras min// chu shing 'bras bu da rar min// ta li 'bras bu zhor mi 'phrod// tsha ba gnyis po bu ram dang*// sbrang rtsi ka ka ma btsir min// de bzhin nya btsos phan gnod dang*// do kha btsos pa bcos pa min// ka ma ra ni snod gzhan du// btsos na nyin mtshan lon mi za// da ni sman gyi nus pa rgyas par bshad pa bzhugs so// 'gro ba'i nad sel bcom ldan 'das// drang srong chen po tshangs la sogs// drang srong bla ma brgyud pa la// bstud de gus pas phyag btsal nas// rin chen rdo dang chu dang shing*// rtsi dang sngo ldum bye brag dang*// srog chags las byung sha las byung*// so so'i nus pa bshad par bya// lha klu gnod sbyin mi'am ci// spyod pa bshad kyang rnyed mi 'gyur// sman gyi rgyal po bril byed sogs// mang shes ldan pa'i spyod yul min// 'dir ni rnyed cing nyer mkho ba// cung zad bshad par 'dir shes bya// rgyal ba'i ring bsrel nor bu'i mchog

/dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar byed// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems// de bzhin rnal 'byor ldan pa'i gdung*// mchod cing lus la bcang ba yis// gdon kun phyogs su nye mi nus// nor bu rin chen baiḍūr ya// 'od kyis nad rnams sel bar byed// iṇ+ḍa ni las nad kun sel// rdo rje thog kun bzlog par byed// pad+ma rā gas dug kun 'phrog /mar gad nad rnams kun la phan// byi la'i mig 'dra sbrul chen mdog /chu shel tshad pa zhi bar byed// me shel grang ba'i nad rnams 'joms// kar ka'i kra'i gzer ba sel// sbur len dug tshad thams cad 'joms// de ltar rdo yi nor bu bcu// bya khyung skyugs pas nad kun phan// de bzhin g.yu rnying nus pa mtshungs// mu men dug dang skran nad 'joms// mu tig dug sel klad pa gso// phra men gza' nad ma lus sel// byi ru lus pa'i nad la phan// shang shang shi gas gdon kun bsrungs// phal ba'i gdung sel 'dril kun 'jigs// gzi rnying mig nad sel bar byed// 'chong dang mar gad de dang 'dra// rdo dang srog chags las byung bcu// lce spyang ra yi nor rnams bsrungs// sbrul gyi nor bu'i dug la phan// ku sha bhan+dhas rims nad sel// gser lhe dbyig dug bsdud cing sel// reg gcod skran nad 'joms par byed// gla ba'i nor bu'i sbrul dug phan// nya sog srog chags klad pa'i nang*// rdo ba char 'bebs so sor phan// chu tshan rims sel gdon nad sel// nya phyi'i klad pa 'dzag pa gcod// 'ju byed shel rdo dug la phan// de ltar nor bu'i char rdo dang*// ro bcud rgyal po dngul chu ni// gnyen po grogs sbyar kun nad sel// tshe ring nor rnams las kun 'grub// gser gyis rgas pa rnam par 'joms// dngul gyis so ni bzang por gyur// lcags kyis chu dang mtshon rnams bzlog /zangs kyis dmu rdzing skem par byed// 'khar ba ra gan mig nad sel// klu ni nag dang dkar ba gnyis// gdon bsrung spu rnams nag por byed// 'di rnams lcags brgyad gnyen pos sad// yon tan kun ldan shes par bya// de bas khams rnams brjod bya ste// khab len rigs ni rnam pa lnga// 'gugs byed lcags rnams 'gugs par byed// gcod byed 'big byed skor byed rnams// lcags kun las byed khams mchog yin// mtshal gyis rtsa sbyong dug nad sel// gser dngul rdo yang de dang mtshungs// zangs rdo mthing spang nad kun skyugs// rag rdos mig gi rab rib sel// ti tsha dmar nag chu ser skems// pha wang dkar pos mig la phan// nag po gru bzhi khyi smyon phan// gser zil zangs dang nus pa mtshungs// dngul zil rdo dug sil bar byed// ldong ros gag pa'i sman mchog yin// bab las gdon nad sel bar byed// mu zi mdze nad chu ser skems// nag po lhog pa'i nad la phan// mu ljang gnyan tshad sel bar byed// mtshur nag rigs ni gsum gyis kyang*// dbyig dug sel zhing kha nad sel// dar mtshur rus nad phal cher 'joms// lhang tsher dug nad kun sel byed// khams brgya nye bcud cur bcas yin// 'di rnams so sor dug bsad gces// de bas rdo gzhan yon tan ni// dung 'dra dngul chu 'ching bar byed// smug po mig gdon nad kun phan// bye'u mgo yi rus chag sbyor// sbal rgyab chu ser nad la phan// mdung rtse dkar smug mig nad sel// dkar po chig thub rus tshad sel// gang thig 'brum pa'i chu ser skems// 'brug klad klad pa'i nad la phan// cong zhis rus pa'i dwangs ma gso// de ltar bcu po mgo chag dang*// chu ser nad rigs kun la phan// rdo zhos snod kyi nad rnams sel// phug ron ske yis lcags dred 'joms// dkar po lug gdong skran nad 'joms// rta glo kha 'dras 'dril rnams bshig

/skyung kha rgyab khras glo skran phan// ser po mchin mkhris 'dril rnams sel// go bo'i rgyab 'dras grang gnyen sel// tsha rdos grang nad phal cher 'joms// rdo sol dbyig gi dug la phan// mu zi rdo yis dmu chu skems// 'di bcu bsregs la btang bar bya// rdo mkhris mkhris pas mig ser sel// rdo skyur grang ba bad kan sel// rdo rus rus pa'i nad la phan// lung rdo rtsa yi nad rnams 'joms// sna bas rma yi nad la phan// chu tshad pa'i nad sel byed// brag rdos grang ba sel bar byed// rdo chu dngul gyi dug la phan// rgya mtsho lbu bas gdon nad sel// tho lo dkar gyis rtsa lam sel// 'di bcu grogs dang bsreg par gces// rdo spos 'dus pa'i nad la phan// dkar gong srin can dro srin sel// rgya mtsho'i rdo bas srin la phan// smugs kyis rma yi chu ser skems// ka sha'i rdos kyang dngul chu sbyong*// dngul chu'i rdo bsreg sha ro gcod// dug shel dug nag sel ba yin// mdzeng gi rma rnying sel bar byed// las byed 'du ba snyoms pa yin// yam pa khams gang yin par mthun// sna tshogs nus ldan rdo ba bcu*// gzhan yang ro nus 'dres pa rnams// nus pas nad rnams zhi byed pa// mkhas pas tshul bzhin dpyad byas la// gtong lugs mkhas pa'i zhal la dris// de nas chu sman bshad par bya// mkha' las 'bab dang gaṅgā dang*// sa phyogs dkar nag gtsang ma 'bab// 'tsho byed ngom byed yid khar 'ong*// tshims byed sems ni gsal byed la// sla zhing ro mi gsal ba zhim// bsil zhing yang ba yan lag brgyad// ldan pa bdud rtsi lta bu yin// chu skol yan lag brgyad dang ldan// rlung gnon bad kan 'byin par byed// me drod bskyed cing dwangs snyigs 'byed// skom sel skol grang nyes gsum sel// chu ni zhag lon nyes gsum bskyed// gangs chu tshad sel grang nad bskyed// shing lcum mang ba bad kan bskyed// gcong bzhi'i chu yis smug po sel// khron pa'i chu yis mkhris pa sel// chu tshan rigs ni lnga yod de// yan lag brgyad kyi nad kun phan// chu skyur pags nad bad kan sel// ba tsha ldan pas rlung nad 'joms// kha ru tsha bro ma zhu sel// mu tig dri ldan chu ser skems// de bzhin sman chu lnga yod de// rgya tsha'i ro ldan nad kun phan// skyur po'i ro ldan bad rlung sel// bsil la ro kha tshad nad sel// ra zhob pho ba ma zhu sel// dri chu mtshungs bas nad kun sel// kun gyi sbyongs dang skyugs pa yin// khyad par can gyi chu rnams ni// rdo chu dug chu byi chu dang*// chu shes chu dang bcod pa'i chu// re re la'ang lnga lnga ste// dngul chu 'ching bar byed pa yin// na ra k+ṣa ra ghu'u dang*// a sha shu na ha thi ti// dri chu lnga ni dngul chu 'khru// zhi sogs dri chu mang po yi// yon tan dpag med 'dir ma brjod// nad rnams bskyed par byed pa'i chu// steng ka 'dam rdzab nya lcibs can// mtsho dang lu ma snyog pa can// lbu ba srog chags mang dang bro// grang rjes so yi mi bzod dang*// char gang dus su ma babs dang*// dus kyi dang por babs pa dang*// srog chags chu dang dug 'dres dang*// gcin ci 'dres pa'i chu rnams ni// gal te 'thung na legs par btsag

/dwangs snyigs phye la legs par bskol// lbu ba bcad la btung bar bya// de ltar nad sel nyi shu lnga// nad rnams bskyed byed bcu gsum ste// gzhan yang sna tshogs rkyen gyis bsgyur// mkhas pas zhib tu brtags te btung*// de nas shing sman bshad par bya// a ka ru nag pos srog rtsa dang*// snying gi tshad rlung thams cad sel// a ka ru dmar pos rlung tshad 'joms// su ru tsan dan de dang 'dra// tsan dan dkar po dri ldan gyis// bcud len dri med tshad rkyang sel// dmar pos khrag rlung 'thab pa sel// smug pos tshad pa kun la phan// rdo ba dha rus tshad pa sel// u dum 'bar ba bcud mtshan yin// a shad rta dang sha gla rta// ne gre rta dang mchod sbyin shing*// ha sa ka ra bhes kam ka// gham pa ri de sa me 'am// a sam ka pa la sha 'di// bcud len chen po bcu sel zhing*// grub pa yang ni ster bar bshad// seng ldeng mdze dang chu ser skems// na ri ki las bad mkhris sel// go mo lus zungs 'das bar byed// star gas rlung nad sel bar byed// tsam pa ka yis tshad pa 'joms// dong ga'i shing gis dug la phan// 'brug shing char 'bebs klu nad sel// shing 'dus 'dus pa'i nad sel byed// tsal se shing gi dug la phan// dar shing rus nad kun la phan// 'di bcu 'bras bu'i sman mchog yin// shug pas smad kyi tshad pa sel// 'bras bu bdud rtsi bcud du bshad// spa ma'i nus pa de dang mtshungs// lcang mas dmu chu'i nad la phan// sbyar bas byer bar sdud pa yin// spyi thar mgo rus chag pa sbyor// glang mas mo nad tshad pa sel// ltag pas lus zungs brtas par byed// be shing chu ser 'dren pa yin// ghu dang khres pa 'du ba snyoms// de ltar bcu po shing sman yin// grum shig las ni dmag 'byung ste// be nag 'bras bu mon cha ra// 'khru ba gcod pa'i dam pa yin// spos dkar shing dang spos nag shing*// chu ser sel ba'i dam pa yin// mdung shing thang chus rma kun phan// 'dre krog shing gis gnyan tshad sel// dug kha ma shing 'bras nad sbyong*// sgron shing skran nad kun la phan// star shing dug dang glo nad sel// rgya mtha' tshad pa sel bar byed// yon tan can gyi shing bcu'o// skyer pas dug sel mig la phan// se bas rtsa sbubs nad rnams bsdud// 'om bus dug tshad ma lus 'joms// rgya lcang bar shun skyug pa'i sman// khyi shing glo mig bad kan 'dren// 'phang ma 'bras bus snying nad sel// bra ma sha yi nad rnams 'joms// skyur shing bad kan sel ba yin// gro ba mgo chag chu ser 'dren// bse rgod bar shun dug tshad bsdu// 'di bcu bar shun bzung bar bya// da lis grang rlung kun sel lo// su ru de dang phyogs mthun drod// spe ma ma zhu glo nad sel// mtshe yis rma gso skrang rnams 'dul// ja shing tshad pa kun la phan// shing sngon gyis kyang tshad pa 'joms// skyer shing 'bras bus gag pa sel// yung shing tshad pa snyoms par byed// rma shad rma gso chu ser 'dren// snyug mas mkhal ma'i zungs 'dzin byed// 'di bcu rnyed sla kun tu rgyugs// lha shing phur mos rnag chu skems// mdzo tshe tsan dan dmar por mtshungs// g.yer ma'i shing gis rtsa lam 'byed// gla tsher ba yang bsil bar gtogs// gsom dang rgya shing thang shing gsum// bsil snyoms phyogs su rtogs pas te// thang chus rma yi chu ser 'dren// ma he'i shing gis glo nad sel// rtsod kyis rgyu long tshad pa sel// shing dmar char mos tshad pa sel// de ltar bcu gsum bsil la snyoms// gzhan yang 'bras bu rtsi sman rnams// phal cher shing las 'byung mod kyi// de ltar 'og tu brjod par bya// rtsi sman rgyal po ga bur te// kan rtsa ga bur rgyas tshad sel// shel ni rtsub bsil de dang 'dra// stag gzig ser snyan khrag mkhris sel// mang ni rlung ldan tshad pa 'joms// gur gum mchin tshad khrag la phan// ku ku ma yang de phyogs mthun// 'jam shing gis ni rlung tshad 'joms// cu gang glo nad kun la phan// de rigs pa dang shing 'byung gnyis// ka ko la ni mcher tshad phan// e la zhes bya shin tu tsha// li shis gzer nad mchin mkhris gso// sug rmel pho long gzhi 'dzin byed// bsil drod snyoms pa gnyis gnyis drug

/gi waṃ tshad nad kun la phan// gla rtsi gnyan tshad dug la phan// gu gum nag pos gdon tshad 'joms// de ltar rtsi sman gtso bo bcu// bzang ngan yul gyi sum cu yod// shing kun rlung nad thams cad 'joms// sbo ga t+ta'i dngul chu mtshungs// ru rta dkar dang nag po gnyis// tshad 'khrugs gnyan nad srog rlung sel// ut+pal glo mchin tshad pa 'joms// se yab bad kan sel ba ste// se 'bru bad rlung kun gzhi 'joms// bye mas mkhal nad rtsa nad sel// k+sho bsam se'i nad la shis// ur shir ras kyang snod nad sel// 'di bcu kun la shis pa'i ris// po son cha yis nad rnams skyugs// gser gyi phur bus stod du 'dren// gser gyi me tog mkhris pa'i sman// ku ba dong kha de dang mtshungs// yung bas gzhang 'brum sel ba'i gtso// shing mngar glo tshad kun la phan// tsi ṭa ka yis me drod bskyed// shang ka sus pas sha cher skyed// sle tres 'du ba snyoms par byed// kan+dha ka ri de 'dra bcu// shin tu sbyor ba phal la gces// so ma ra dzas mdze nad sel// til dkar nag po rlung nad sel// tha kar gza' dang chu ser sel// kun gyi chu ser 'dus pa skems// na ga ge sar pus pa dang*// pad+ma ge sar pus pa yis// gdon sel dbang po'i nad sel bcu// gla gor glo nad bad kan phan// mkhal ma zho sha rigs gsum dang*// a 'bras 'jam 'bras sran 'bras gsum// mkhal nad grang nad kun la phan// grang nad kun 'joms na le sham// nyes pa gsum sel pi pi ling*// bad rlung sel ba sga skya mchog /dong khra glo nad gyen du 'dren// 'di bcu bad rlung 'joms pa'i mchog ba sha ka yis khrag nad sel// ba la kha yis khrag 'khrugs snyoms// gla sgang glo ba'i tshad pa 'joms// li ga dur gyis dug thabs 'jig /ka ser rgyu long tshad 'khru sel// bha bu lu yis glo tshad sel// shu dag dkar pos sha cher bskyed// nag pos gnyan tshad gyen du 'dren// nim pa tshad nad kun la phan// rgun 'brum byis pa'i glo nad sel// stod kyi tshad sel sman mchog bcu// ko byi la yis dug tshad sel// ldum ltag glang chen dang mtshungs// shang kang bum pa a 'jong bsngo// bya 'phur leb dang su mi sman// dpa' bo dkar ser dmar po gsum// 'di bcus dug tshad thams cad 'joms// rkyang pa gnyis gsum gang tshogs sbyar// byi thang dang ga ma ru rtse// la la phud rnams srin la phan// 'brum gyis ya ma'i nad rnams 'joms// lang thang rtse'ang de bzhin no// er ma che chung rtsa srin sel// dwa rgod rtsa bas srin nad sel// 'bras bu ma spang de dang 'dra// zi bham khrag 'khrugs nad la phan// bhi ta rtsa srin rlung srin sel// de ltar srin rnams sel ba bcu// khyung sder dkar smug dug sel la// go phye rmug po sel ba'i mchog

/'u su glang thabs sgang sel mchog /glang mgo grang chu sel ba'i mchog /sga tig tsha chu sel ba'i mchog /rus pa gso ba a bhi mchog /dan rog sbyong byed gso byed mchog /klu yi gnyen po rlug dug yin// shi la me drod rdo skran 'joms// de ltar mchog gi sman bcu'o// a ru ra la rigs bdun yod// bcud kyi len la sha chen te// dri dang shal ma snyung po mchog /rnam rgyal 'jigs byed gdon la bsngags// 'tsho ba gtsang pa 'phel ba gsum// tha ma shes bya de rnams so// ba ru ra dang skyu ru ra// 'dus pa'i nad rnams sel bar byed// snying zho sha yis snying nad sel// dong khas smug po byer ba sbyong*// e ran ta yis nad rnams 'khru// pad+ma rtsa los lus zungs skyed// ma nu ru rtas 'du ba snyoms// pa ṭa bad tshad 'joms par byed// spus dkar rtsibs logs gzer ba sel// shu zur nus pa de dang mtshungs// bcu gcig 'dus pa so sor mngar// me tog gsum pas gag pa sel// dharma na mchog rdar du 'joms// skyu rtsi chen pos bad kan sel// ghir ta kur ba dngul chu 'ching*// zhu mkhan kha'i nad rnams sel// ram ni gdon gyi nad la phan// da trig 'khru gcod dbugs nad sel// ra ti ldong ros dug zhi byed// za khyab dmu chu'i nad la phan// shing kha yis kyang dug la phan// sna tshogs nus ldan bcu yin no// rtsa ba'i drag chen lnga po yis// cha du ba dang sing gi dang*// ka la ku da ni la dang*// ser po dang lnga bong rigs// gnyan sel rnams 'jig par byed// gang ga mi yi dngul chu 'chings// dha ru ra ni srin kun phan// 'ol ma bse yi khal nad sel// bha ma dan ti bho ga te// nye ba'i dug lnga yon tan can// ming gi lnga ni 'gar byed// ghi ra ra tsa tsud byed// ut+pa ling ga las rnams 'grub// bhi shu kra ma bha ra ni// dpa' bo gcig pu ral pa dmar// bhim dhim dang lan dza mu// zin tig bcu so dngul chu 'chings// gdon bsrung nad rnams zhi bar byed// de nas sngo rnams bshad par bya// spri yang ku yis mchin tshad sel// cu gang sgog skyas glo nad sel/

go snyod snying tshad rlung nad sel// snya lo rgyu long tshad pa sel// bre kha mkhal ma'i nad kun phan// 'di lnga bzang po lnga dang mtshungs// bong nga dkar pos rims rnams sel// dmar pos dug tshad sel ba yin// ser po de dang rjes su mthun// yu gu shing dang glang ru gnyis// phag glang zhes bya dug kun 'joms// par pa ta yis khrag tshad sel// hong len de dang 'dra ba yin// khu mang zho can dbyi dug sel// spang tsi do bos dug tshad sel// brag skyas sbyar dug bsdud cing gsod// gnyan tshad chu ser skem pa'i mchog /khyi lce nag pos gnyan skrangs sel// dkar pos mdze nad dug tshad 'joms// spang spos tsha skrangs 'dul bar byed// gnyan thub dri chen gnyan nad 'joms// mus me rde ba de dang 'dra// 'di bcus gnyan tshad 'joms pa yin// bshang dril dkar pos nad la mchog /dmar po dri can gdon tshad phan// sngon pos glo rnag zhi bar byed// ser po tshad pa kun la phan// drag po ral pas gza' nad sel// zil tig de mtshungs mig la phan// bya rgod sug pa de dang 'dra// g.yu gdong gser mgo gdong tshad phan// a byag chen po nad rnams 'joms// sngo rnams 'byung ba'i nad zhi byed// 'di bcu gdon tshad spyi sman yin// g.ya' khyis mkhris pa zhi sbyong byed// re kon pa yis khrag tshad 'joms// stong ri mkhris sman mkhris tshad 'joms// rtsa mkhris nag dang dkar ba gnyis// rtsa gso mkhris pa'i nad la phan// khra rkang lcags kyus tshad pa sel// gang ga chu dang ga bur mtshungs// rgu grus gnod tshad 'joms pa yin// gcad 'byor rtsa chad mthud par byed// chags sbyar rus pa sbyor byed de// 'di kun khrag mkhris kun la phan// rtag tu ngu yis mig nad sel// a ba dang ni a 'dra gnyis// mig gsal zha rengs sel bar byed// ug chos rtsa gso rna bar phan// khrag chen ru rta nus pa mtshungs// 'khrugs sel rna ba 'byed pa yin// khrog chung skyung thog 'bras bu yis// klad pa 'dzag pa gcod pa yin// sug pa dag byed sna nad sbyongs// sro lo dkar pos glo tshad 'joms// dmar pos tshad sel kha tri sbyongs// 'di bcus dbang po'i nad rnams 'joms// 'bri ta rnag bskems rnag glag phan// sog le'i kha yis khrag tshad sel// yu mo srol gong mgo la phan// mde 'byin bu 'byin chu ser skems// klad srin nus pa de dang 'dra// chu chal dar yag rma tshad sel// chu rtsi dar yag dug la phan// me tog dar nad kun la phan// ser chen rnag dang stod tshad 'joms// te rmig mgo yi nad la phan// mgo dang yan lag byang khog la// gang tshogs phan pa rnam pa bcu// sa sel rigs ni rnam bzhi yod// tshad pa bad kan snyoms par byed// me tog rgyun ma rnam pa bzhi// phrag ro 'dod byed bsil ba rnams// phyung bcud dkar dmar tshad pa sel// 'di bcu bsil snyoms gzhan gyi grogs// bha bo yan lag skrang rnams 'joms// klu dug chung dus skrangs rnams sel// me tog dkar pos khrag 'khru sel// chu ma rtsi yis skom pa sel// spang rgyan dkar pos glo tshad sel// sngon po de dang phyogs mthun bsil// g.yag ru rigs gsum chu ser skems// rta lpags smug pos tsha skrangs 'dul// lums dang khong btang gang 'os bcu// bsil sdebs rgya rtsa bstan pa ste// re re gnyis gsum nad sdebs nas// don snod khrag mkhris gsar rnying sel// sbyar byus byas na nad kun 'joms// zwa rgod 'bras bu drod kyi gtso// tshad pa kun slong grang ba sel// glang rna bsil kyang chu 'gag sel// dbyi mong dkar pos long skran sel// nag po de dang mtshungs pa yin// sub kas grang skran thams cad 'joms// lce tsha ba yis gag pa sel// do ba rum gcod chu ser 'dren// shu mo za yis rnag rnams skems// bre khas mkhal nad grang nad sel// srog khas rtsa nad ma lus sel// 'di bcu phan tshun sdebs pa yis// skran 'jig chu ser ma lus 'dren// rtsa nad rtsa chu 'gag pa sel// rma rgan phol 'bras kun la phan// grogs su bse 'bru rgyal tsha sbyor// 'bu su hang gis mkhal mar phan// srad nag dug rnams 'dren par byed// srad dkar glo tshad sel ba'i mchog

/srad sngon srad ser gnyis yod de// srad smug rmu chu dag la phan// rgyal mo chu 'byin chu 'byin gnyis// grang chu tshad chu kun 'dren mchog /bal sran chu 'bebs 'jig pa byed// srad ma dri can gdon nad sel// 'di bcu bsil drod rkyen gyis bsgyur// rlung nad kun la sgog skya mchog /lo ma de dang phyogs mthun yin// btsong nag rkag 'bam grang ba sel// sham dang chab bla chu ru dang*// btsong dmar nus pa de dang 'dra// rgya ba 'dzim dang dha go gsum// srin dang chu ser grang ba sel// rme mo che chung bcud len yin// lus zungs gso zhing rlung nad 'joms// ra li phyogs mthun drod yin no// go byi rgod kyi srin rnams 'joms// zangs rtsi dkar po rnag skem drod// 'di gsum nus pa phyogs mthun yin// rug pa byi rug srin la phan// thul pa phyi thul snyoms pa ste// dug la gnas skabs la lar phan// sha ba rtsi yis srin rnams sel// de ltar drod ldan srin gsod bcu// mi 'dra lus zungs thams cad bskyed// dbang po lag pas dwangs ma bskyed// a zho an+dhas sha bskyed la// lcang ba gze ba nye'u shing*// ram nye'i rtsa ba 'di rnams kyi// bcud len mkhal ma'i grang nad sel// ko bang lus zungs 'phel ba ste// grang ba sel la smug po bskyed// snyi ba rtsa nad grang ba 'joms// 'di bcus ro btsa' grang ba sel// dur byid nad rnams sbyongs pa ste// thar nus gnyan rnams sbyongs pa yin// khron bus sbyong byed grogs kyi mchog /sngon bus nad rnams mthur la 'dren// shog shing sngon bu sbyong gi mchog /chu rtsa lcum rtsa chu bun dang*// la lcum pa yi lo ma rkang*// drod ldan bad kan grang ba sel// rtsa ba bsil snyoms nad kun 'khru// re lcags gnyen sbyong rus pa gcod// de ltar sbyong byed rnam la bcu// sbal pa lag pas sngo chu sel// lo rtsan tsha grang 'khru ba gcod// tha ram nus pa de dang 'dra// na ram ram bu mon bu gsum// drod ldan khrag 'phel 'khru ba gcod// lo rtsan chen po gdon la phan// be snab yis kyang grang ba sel// za 'dra drod kyi phyogs yin la// tsha skyur byed lcim ru rgan sel// de ltar 'khru gcod rnam pa bcu// 'khan dmar grang skran 'dul ba'i mchog

/dkar po mkham ma'i nad la phan// a krong glo mang gsog pa sel// 'khan chung ser mgo de dang mtshungs// er shing mkhal 'dra dug la phan// sgang bu dri bus mkhal rlung sel// g.yu dril nus pa de dang 'dra// nye sgang drod ldan chu 'gags sel// long nyung ldon rtsad du byed// mar nag lo 'bras grang nad sel// glo mkhal grang sel rnam pa bcu// spre sman bcu bsil sha dug phan// byi'u la phug de dang mtshungs// ri sho snyoms te gyen du skyugs// sho mangs skrang dang srin la phan// yungs kar gdon dang dug la phan// chu phun smug po kun la phan// tshan chung spro lo me tshig phan// spyang tsher dkar po nag po dang*// gyen 'dren 'bras dang skrad rnams 'dul// grel 'bras snyoms te srin la phan// bsil drod rkyen gyur sman sna bcu// gla ba'i rtsa dang rgo ba'i rtsa// sgo ba'i me tog kun la phan// spru dkar khrag gcod spru nag gis// gdon skrang 'dul zhing srin la phan// spra ba che chung lug bal dang*// rgyab skra khrag gcod snyoms pa yin// bya rgod spos kyis pags nad sel// g.yag rus ro btsal grang ba 'joms// khrag gcod phan zhing grang sel bcu// de ltar drod sman rgyal po 'di// phan tshun sdebs pas grang nad sel// ku shas sha cher bskyed pa ste// ram rtsa sdig pa'i dug la phan// spu shil rtse yis nad 'joms la// chu srin sder mos rtsa rnams mthud// gang pa de dang phyogs mthun la// ma brgyad smug pos glang thabs sel// snor 'bras bad kan smug por phan// 'jag ma sdug tshad mkhal nad 'khrog /smug chung ldan yon grang ba 'joms// rta bu ka ras khrag ngan 'dren// de ltar rtsa yi rigs gyur bcu// tang kun dkar nag dug tshad bsdu// bye chung dkar dmar drod ral dang*// be lcum de dang mtshungs pa yin// sug 'dra dkar pos glo tshad sel// shong ni mes tshig dug la phan// a bhi sha yis zla mtshan gcod// sga lo ba yang bsil bar gtogs// dom dum srin gyi nad la phan// kyang shog dkar pos mdze nad sel// ser po sngon pos rus tshad 'byin// bsil la snyom pa rnam pa bcu// a byag tsher sngon mgo la bsngags// nad pa nus pas phrag dug sel// sha ba gyid len mig la phan// spor nag dug tshad 'byin par byed// ma mchin de 'dra sbrul la phan// gang btsan sha rus rtsa la phan// na ga pa las rgas pa 'joms// pho rog nor bus glo rnag 'dren// phur chung srin bu don pa ste// le brgan rtsi yis glo nad sel// kha shog mong gi srin rnams la// la phug gis kyang srin la phan// sa rtse ba yis 'khru ba gcod// snyung mos chu rgyud lhog pa sel// sran ma'i me tog mkhal nad sel// lha yi bu mos mkhris pa sel// spra rgod pa yis rma rnams 'dul// yu mos rma rnying 'bras la phan// lug mur bad kan grang ba sel// sne'us rlung brgyas 'byin par byed// nas sog gro sogs khre dang 'bras// so ba sred de sog ma'i tshogs// so so'i chang gis ma zhu sel// bra skog 'bras la phan pa ste// sbo ma yis kyang ya ma sel// sba ma 'bras dang 'dra bar bshad// gzar ma rlung la phan pa yin// be lce tshad pa phal la 'gro// g.yu mo ma yang de bzhin no// gser sha srin rnams 'byin par byed// smug sha mkhris pa rlung sel yin// tsha sha rlung gi nad la phan// ke ru wa tras rlung bskyed byed// dug sha yan lag skrangs la phan// tse sha sha yi dug la phan// pha wang sgo tig mes tshig sel// tha'o 'jo yis mkhris rlung sel// lo dang ku shus dug tshad sel// khams bu ser khams mkhris pa sel// star khun star bu'i glo nad sel// se skyur bad kan sel bar byed// 'ol bse thang 'bras dug la phan// de ltar se gtogs rnam pa bcu// 'bras chen chu 'bras dug tu 'gyur// re 'bras tshad pa 'joms shing sel// sre dang grus pa che chung rnams// rlung skye lus zungs 'ju la 'phrod// nas sngon bsreg pas glo rnag 'dren// rlung la nas rnying zan skom byed// gsar pas mkhris sel bad rlung bskyed// so bas rlung ni bskyed pa yin// gro ni rtsa gso snyoms pa yin// bra'o khrag nad 'jig par byed// sran chen dkar rlung 'joms la// gzhan gyis rlung bskyed lus zungs 'ju// gang du dkon par sman du 'gyur// mod par zas bcos shes par bya// smin dang ma smin ri klung dang*// chu la skyes dang skam la skyes// nus pa'i bye brag mang yod kyang*// 'dir ni mang por mi brjod do// bu ram rlung gi nad la phan// sbrang rtsis rtsa dang dbang po gso// ka ra dkar pos tshad pa sel// kha sha ri yi bcud len te// sbrang rgod grang ba 'joms pa yin// tig ta'i sbrang gi tshad pa 'joms// nyung bur dug gi nad la phan// shug bur rtsa ba bcud kyi rigs// me tog sna tshogs bsdus pa yis// dbang po'i nad rnams sel ba ste// sman ltar sbyor ba so sor bya// rgyam tshas nyes pa gsum ka sel// rgya tshas rtsa sbyongs bdud rtsi yin// ze tshas srin gsod rdo skran 'jog

/mdze tsha rigs gsum chu ser skems// brag tsha skran dang ma zhu sel// lba tshas lba ba smin bur sman// 'jang gi tsha nag de dang mtshungs// kha ru tsha ni drod kyi gtso// rgyu long tshad sel ngo mtshar che// rtsa ru tsha yang de dang 'dra// ra tsha rgyu long grang ba sel// byang tsha dkar po rgyam tshar mtshungs// tsha dmar brag tsha drag por sbyongs// tsha la dkar po de dang 'dra// bul tog nad rnams mthur du 'dren// shing tsha rlung sel glo rnams sel// lce myang tsha yis grang skran sel// thal tsha de dang phyogs mthun drod// thang rgan tsha yis rma 'bras gcod// tsha chus tsha yi ma zhu sel// de ltar tsha sman nyi shu'o// de nas thal sman 'ga' zhig bshad// gser dngul thal bas sha ro gcod// zangs thal chu ser ma lus sel// snya lo'i thal bas rgyu rim sel// khyi lce'i thal bas rtsa nad sel// srad kar thal bas 'dus rims sel// tshe yi thal bas sna khrag gcod// dar zab thal ba de dang mtshungs// 'khan pa phur mo yab mo dang*// be dang shing rul thams cad dang*// stag ma'i thal bas rma 'bras sel// shug sol glo mig bad kan sel// so phag rdza ma dug la phan// thab 'og sa tshig rgyu srin sel// a ru sgron shing sngo tsha gsum// bsregs pas ma zhu skran kun phan// gzhan yang sngo shing rdo kun gyi// rang rang thal ba'i yon tan rnams// 'dir ma bstan pas lag len ltos// de nas srog chags las byung ba// shing rus mkhris pa'i nad rnams la// rags ma'i rim pa 'ga' zhig bshad// mi lus 'di la yon tan mang*// skra yi mar khu zhun chen gnyis// rlung sel chu ser kun la phan// gzhob kyi sna khrag gcod pa'i mchog /mchan bu gdon dang dug la phan// sha chen rlung gnon dug la phan// rus pa gcod pas rma 'bras gcod// thal chen 'byung po thams cad phan// mi dbang ba zan nad la bsngags// 'khru las dwangs ma'i dug zhi byed// dri chu dron mos kha nad sel// dri chu grang mos mig nad sel// dri chen gdon skrang kun la phan// de bzhin lus kyi cha shas kyis// nad sel bcud byed nyer byed yod// rgyas pa rdo rje mkha' 'gror ltos// phyi sha grang ba'i dmu chu skem// rta shas grang ba sel bar byed// glang chen sha rus gdon la bsngags// ba glang sha ni mkhris tshad sel// de ni sha chen rnam pa lnga// kha da si ni stobs bskyed la// na gi dri dang dngul chu 'chings// seng ge'i sha yis gdon dug sel// stag gzig sha yang de dang 'dra// dom gyi sha yis tshad pa sel// dred mong sha yis grang rlung sel// mi 'jod phag rgod ra rgod rnams// bsil la gdon nad sel ba'i rigs// gung dang dbyig dang snyug stag rnams// phyogs mthun bcud ldan gdon nad sel// kha shas gdon sel glo ba yis// glo rnag sel ba'i sman du bshad// 'phyi ba'i sha ni grang rlung sel// grum pa te lo sre mong gsum// gdon nad chu ser skem pa yin// rgod g.yag sha rus rlung sel mchog

/'bri g.yag de dang phyogs mthun drod// lug shas bad kan zhi zhing bcud// rang bzhin bsil bas tshad par 'phrod// phag sha bsil la tshad 'bros la// bong bu'i sha ni rlung kun phan// 'phyi ba g.yag sha'ang drod du gtogs// rgya dang kha sha sha ba gsum// snyan rtsod rna ba gla ri dwags sha rnams snyoms// rkyang dang rta ni phyogs mthun yin// ma he ba men bcud len la// chu sram bcud ldan yon tan mang*// byi las ro btsa' byed pa ste// spyang khus ma zhu sel ba'i mchog /da byid dkyil 'khor 'khu ba gso// rtsangs pa de dang phyogs mthun no// sdig srin mkhal ma'i chu ser 'dren// nya shas rma skran dregs la phan// gser sbrul gnyan nad thams cad sel// lcags sbrul mig nad thams cad sel// sbrul gzhan sha bskyed drod du byed// bya rgod gdon nad sman yin la// go bo'i grod pas ma zhu sel// khra glag bcud dan 'byung po sel// ne le 'ol bar de phyogs mthun// 'ug pa srin byas gdon sel la// rma bya bya bas grang ba sel// dug nad can gyis rten mi rung*// rba gzer shing rta blo bya sogs// khu byug khu dig ne tso dang*// pho rog khyim bya gong mo dang*// sreg pa gu ling chu sreg dang*// byi'u sna tshogs sha rnams kyis// spyir ni lus yang rtsal stobs bskyed// so sor yon tan 'dir ma brjod// phu shud gdon sel pho rog dang*// kha ta gdon dang mkhris la phan// so byas chu 'gag sel ba ste// khrung khrung ngang ngur chu skya dang*// chu bya phal cher bsil ba yin// ka las ṭa ka ro btsa' byed// ri bong klad pas dmar nad sel// thog rus de dang mtshungs pa yin// thog rus mgo nad rus dug /rus sbal rus pas mdze la phan// sre mong rlung mkhris thams cad dang*// mgo rus phal gyis rlung srin sel// mjug chung mkhal rked nad rnams sel// rkang rnams yan lag nad la phan// de ni rus gcod rnam bzhi zer// bya ma byi yis mo nad sel// byad pa rtsa sbyong gtso bo ste// sbur 'gyogs de ni grogs su bzang*// gzhan yang dom mkhris la sogs pa// srog chags phra mo kun la yang*// nus pa so sor dpag med kyang*// snyigs dus sems can sdig can gyis// rang bzhin gnod dogs ma bshad do// rma bya'i mkhris pas klu nad sel// dom 'khris rma tshad mig la phan// g.yag rgod mkhris pas grang nad sel// nya mkhris tshad pa rma tshad sel// phag mkhris tshad sel mig la phan// byi ba'i mkhris pas rma rlung sel// gzhan yang sngar bstan srog chags rnams// phal gyis rma gso tshad pa sel// so so'i nus pa 'dir ma brjod// dug sbrul ra ni sman gyi mchog

/dug dang srin ni 'joms par byed// bse ru dkar pos dug tshad sel// nag po rnag skems snyoms pa yin// kha sha ra yang rnag skems bsil// rgya rus bu 'byin bsil snyoms yin// sha ru chung ngus rnag skems bsil// chen po dmu skem pa dang*// rma rgan 'bras la bsreg btang mchog /rtsod rus 'khru ba gcod pa ste// rgo ba'i rwa yang de dang mtshungs// gnyan gyi nad rnams spyi la phan// ma he'i rwa yis 'or nad sel// mdzo rus lnga bran dug la phan// glang thug rwa ni mgo chag phan// lug gi rwa ni mo nad sel// rgod g.yag g.yag thug rwa yis ni// rma 'bras phol mig nad la phan// rwa ru bsil ba'i phyogs su gtogs// gcin rkyang de dang phyon mthun no// rna ba'i rwa yang tshad par phan// chu glang rwa yang de dang mtshungs// rta rmig rta bong gdon la phan// rwa dang mkhris pa sum cu yod// rma bya'i sgro yis spu dug sel// sgang thur de dang mtshungs pa yin// 'ug pa'i sgro yis glo rnag 'dren// so bya'i mjug sgros chu 'gag sel// go bo'i sgro ser chu rnams skems// pu shud srin bya bya rgod rnams// gdon nad sel ba'i shes par bya// stag gi rma ra dug la phan// bal tshi bskol bas rlung nad sel// re bal tsher pa'i nad la phan// phyi spus skrangs pa'i nad la phan// gzhan yang spu sgo mang yod kyang*// sha dang phyogs mthun 'dir ma brjod// mi rta khyi gsum mar gsar gyis// ril mas dug nad phan par byed// spyang brun gdon nad sel ba yin// khyi brun dkar pos gnyan lhog gsod// phag ril 'brum nag sman mchog yin// khug rta'i brun gyis dmar bshal phan// shing srin brun gyis srin nad sel// gseb sngon sbangs kyis khyi smyon sel// 'di dag re res nad sel ba'i// khyad par khongs su gtogs pa yin// rma bya'i brun gyis gnyan la phan// sha za'i bya rnams kun gyi brun// nus pa gdon skrangs 'dul bar byed// phug ron ril ma la sogs pa// 'bru zan brun gyis grang skran 'dul// gla ba sha ra la sogs pa'i// rtswa zan brun gyis tsha grang 'dul// ba glang mdzo lci la sogs pa// g.yung kun yan lag nad la phan// tsha sel rnams la chu grang sbyar// grang ba rnams la tsha rus khu// gzhang sman gzhi yi so sor sbyar// rgyas pa 'dir ni ma bshad do// ba ra'i mar gyis mkhris pa sel// 'bri lug mar gyis rlung rnams sel// ba men mdzo mos nyes gsum sel

//'bru mar thams cad rlung la phan// shing 'bras ngo bo bzhin shes bya// zhun mar kun la shis pa yod// 'o rlon rnams kyis bad kan bskyed// bzhos thog legs bskol nad kun phan// rta bong 'o mas grang ba sel// zho ni bad kan 'khrum dang mthud// grang ba sel ba'i dam pa'o// chur khus de rnams 'ju byed sbyong*// de ltar brgyad brgya bcu phrag gsum// lhag pa'i sman nus bshad pa 'di// gangs can rgya bod phal na yod// ming gi rnam grangs yul skad kyis// du ma bshad kyang phal cher 'dus// blo ldan rnams kyis zhib tu dpyod// rtsa ba dgun la lo ma sos// me tog sos kha 'bras bu ston// khams rnams rgyas pa'i dus su blangs// sha rnams dar babs glo bur bzang*// rin chen rdo shing deng med blangs// rkyang par gtong na sman rta gces// sngo dang khams rnams 'jam rtsal la// 'dug 'dod grogs dang sdebs shes na// nad rnams ma lus 'joms par byed// snyigs dus nad mang rtsi sman dkon// de phyir gzhan la phan sems nas// gzhung mang dam pa du ma las// gsung rnams phyogs gcig bsdus pa ni// drang srong brgyud pa'i rjes zhugs la// rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba yin// 'gro ba'i nad rnams sel bar shog /sman rnams kyi yon tan phyogs re bstan pa yin no// re re'ang grogs dang sdebs na nad mang po 'joms pa yod de// yi ge mang dogs ma bris so/ nad so so'i sbyor ba gzhung bzhin shes par mdzod cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
